jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Marketing is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead builder enablement programs within Marketing Strategy, Operations & Enablement (MSOE). In this role, you will serve as the strategic lead for cross-functional programs that develop and empower AWS Marketing builders — including early career talent, people managers, and the broader marketing population — to grow, deliver results, and enable their teams.  
  
You will develop and execute program strategy as the single-threaded owner of three flagship programs: the Early Career Talent (ECT) program, Inside AWS Marketing Spotlight Series (IAMSS), and AWS Marketing Manager Central. These programs share knowledge globally and create experiences that raise the bar for builders at every level.  
  
The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader who thrives in ambiguity, earns trust across organizational boundaries, and leverages qualitative and quantitative data to continuously evolve programs. You think big about strategy, dive deep into execution, and communicate with clarity and confidence to senior leaders.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
Early Career Talent (ECT) Program (~60%)  
Lead the ECT program end-to-end — developing and executing the experience strategy for interns and their managers from post-offer acceptance through offboarding.  
Drive manager enablement across the full lifecycle: preparation, onboarding, intern project planning, performance management resources, and serving as the central point of contact to unblock success.  
Design and deliver intern programming — including pre-Day One communications, org-specific onboarding, skill-building sessions, Ask Me Anythings, and lunch-and-learns — that provides an expansive, diversified experience.  
Inspect program quality through surveys, focus groups, and 1:1 mechanisms; identify and act on improvement opportunities.  
Own year-round program strategy, including postmortems, operating plans, and experience strategy documents that codify execution and think big about amplifying impact.  
Build and execute a brand strategy for the ECT program to improve awareness and engagement across AWS Marketing, including among the Marketing Leadership Team (MLT).  
Lead the ECT Tiger Team with cross-functional partners (AUTA, PXT, Finance, Talent Acquisition, WFP) — owning agendas, tracking milestones, and driving accountability.  
  
Inside AWS Marketing Spotlight Series (~20%)  
Own the IAMSS program strategy and vision, including the content calendar, themes, and tenets grounding each session.  
Partner with the CMO's Communications team to prioritize topics; identify and recruit speakers, serving as the final decision maker on content and program direction.  
Develop promotion mechanisms to drive attendance and prime the funnel for future sessions.  
Inspect attendee feedback and evolve the series format and strategy accordingly.  
  
AWS Marketing Manager Central (~20%)  
Own the Manager Central Quick app, including quarterly content refreshes to keep action items and timelines current.  
Maintain a 2–3 day SLA on responding to manager feedback submitted through the app.  
Partner with PXT bimonthly to review feedback, make go/no-go decisions, and incorporate approved inputs into the manager enablement strategy roadmap.  
Inspect performance via feedback trends and app analytics (unique visitors, engagement patterns) to identify improvement opportunities.

------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of an all-source analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing the intelligence community is no longer how to get more data, it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data, and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security.

  

As a Defense Critical Infrastructure All-Source Analyst on our team, you’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client understand their mission environment. You'll work with interagency teams to determine threats to DoD critical infrastructure, providing executive clients with threat briefings and mitigation opportunities. This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills, and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our policymakers.

  

Join us. The world can’t wait.

* Experience in identifying threats to U.S. interests and executing directed tasks supporting the Defense Critical Infrastructure Program, Defense Foreign Material Program, DoD Analytic Agenda, Defense Acquisition System, and Technology Security Program
* Experience with strategic all-source intelligence analysis, including using analytic tools to research data from multiple intelligence sources and analyzing findings
* Experience with authoring current DoD product lines and utilizing ICD 203 tradecraft standards
* Ability to develop high-quality deliverables tailored to senior policymakers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings

jobs.description:
**Program Manager**

Hanover, MD, United States (On-site)

**Job Title:** Program Manager

**Job Code:** TS1681

**Location:** Hanover, MD

**Reports to:** Cherokee Federal Program Manager

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Supervisory:** No supervisory/management authority

**Prepared Date:** 10/7/2026

**A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.**

**This position requires an active Top Secret/SCI clearance.**

***Position Summary:***

Cherokee Insights is seeking a skilled Program Manager to support the Defense Counterintelligence Security Agency (DCSA) Vetting Risk Operations. The successful candidate will support our client, working closely with intelligence analysts, collectors, investigators, and government agencies to provide critical intelligence products and services. The Program Manager will be responsible for coordinating and overseeing the execution of intelligence analysis projects, ensuring timely and high-quality deliverables.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

**Starting Salary Range for Program Manager:** $140,000 – $155,000

**Benefits That Set Us Apart**

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

**Highlights include:**

* Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security

* Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage

* Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options

* Short-term and long-term disability coverage

* Paid holidays

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options

* Professional development, training, and certification support

* Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

***Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:***

Includes the following:

* Responsible for the performance of work on the program

* Oversee the daily operation of the program

* Utilize Microsoft Office software programs, including Word, Excel, Project, Access, Outlook, and PowerPoint, to support intelligence analysis activities.

* Demonstrate familiarity with Intelligence Community (IC) databases, analytical intelligence tools, software, and applications.

* Conduct pattern, trend, and link analysis of intelligence reporting, message traffic, and other data sources.

* Collaborate effectively with intelligence analysts, collectors, and investigators to enhance analysis efforts.

* Draft, review, publish, and evaluate Intelligence Information Reports (IIR) or other IC products.

* Possess strong writing skills to prepare information memoranda, briefings, intelligence reports, and policy assessments for DoD customers.

* Provide subject matter expertise in advising and consulting on intelligence trends and threats related to counterintelligence and Foreign Intelligence Entities (FIE).

* Perform liaison activities with DoD, IC, and Federal Law enforcement to facilitate mission evolution.

* Review and analyze up-to-date information derived from sensitive investigations.

* Compile collected intelligence and create summary products.

* Draft Expedited Screening Information Reports (ESIRs) for dissemination and furtherance of investigative techniques, information sharing, and referrals.

* Ensure compliance with all required training, including completion of DCSA annual training.

* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

***Supervisory Responsibilities:***

No supervisory/management authority

***Basic Qualifications:***

* Bachelors Degree Preferred
* Ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously
* Must be a US Citizen.
* This position requires an active Top Secret/SCI clearance.
* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
* Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

***Work Environment:***

Work is performed primarily in a climate-controlled environment.

**Company Information:**

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. Cherokee Insights, part of Cherokee Federal, the federal contracting division of Cherokee Nation Businesses, is that team. We modernize aging systems, deliver care where it’s needed most, and keep missions supplied, staffed, and moving across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. For more than 60 federal clients, we take on the work others won’t, and deliver where it counts. If that’s the kind of work you’re looking for, you’ve found your team. Learn more at cherokee-federal.com.

**#CherokeeFederal #LI-SO1 #IntelCareers**

Cherokee Federal is a military friendly employer. Veterans and active military transitioning to civilian status are encouraged to apply.

**Legal Disclaimer:** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected veteran status, disability or any other status protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Many of our job openings require access to government buildings or military installations. Candidates must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

In compliance with Maryland’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the salary range for this position is $140,000 – $155,000 and is available to applicants upon request.

jobs.title: Security Analyst - Technical Security - Entry to Experienced Level (Maryland)
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

Security and Counterintelligence is responsible for the protection of NSA/CSS information, people, and facilities worldwide. In support of this mission, Security personnel oversee the development, installation, and maintenance of physical security systems. Security personnel help maintain integral elements of an overall security theory, posture, and infrastructure designed to efficiently deter, delay, detect and identify threats to NSA people, resources and facilities.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Federal employees - Excepted service**

Current federal employees whose agencies have their own hiring rules, pay scales and evaluation criteria.

### **Veterans**

Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces or a spouse, widow, widower or parent of a veteran, who may be eligible for derived preference

### **Military spouses**

Military spouses of active duty service members or whose spouse is 100 percent disabled or died on active duty.

  

**Duties**
----------

Security and Counterintelligence is responsible for the protection of NSA/CSS information, people and facilities worldwide. In support of this mission, Technical Security Analysts provide security analysis, risk recommendations, and mitigations to decision makers and customers. They develop and monitor the implementation and effectiveness of countermeasures for mitigating security risks. Technical Security Analysts prepare and maintain assessments and security databases detailing the findings, recommendations, status, and results of assessment actions.
  
  
Technical Security Analyst responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Applying principles, methods, and tools for assessing and mitigating threats/vulnerabilities
* Understanding commercial information technology marketplace, products, and services
* Assessing applicability of available tools to various situations
* Understanding the principal methods and techniques of gathering intelligence information
* Evaluating the scope and availability of intelligence analysis tools available at NSA
* Preparing and maintaining files, risk assessments, and technical security databases detailing the findings, recommendations, status, and results of assessment actions.
* Developing and monitoring implementation and effectiveness of countermeasures for mitigating security risks.
* Briefing customers and managers concerning technical security policy and procedures and specific cases.
* Applying technical security policy and regulations
* Using resources effectively and efficiently to arrange information in a useful manner
* Obtaining, evaluating, organizing, and maintaining information
* Disseminating information to appropriate internal and external parties
* Creating a product based on analysis of security and/or counterintelligence data
* Providing timely and accurate responses to requests for assistance, information, products or services
* Authoring routine and/or detailed documents such as assessments, reports, and memorandums
* Completing coursework and certifications through the US Air Force TEMPEST School and/or the Interagency Training Center.

  
The agency is currently hiring Security Analysts to specialize in:
  

* Technical Security

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* All applicants and employees are subject to random drug testing in accordance with Executive Order 12564.

### **Qualifications**

The qualifications listed are the minimum acceptable to be considered for the position.
  
  
Relevant experience must be in one or more of the following: signals analysis, intelligence analysis, financial analysis, research analysis, physical or personnel security, TEMPEST, radio frequency, counterintelligence, electrical/electronics, technical surveillance countermeasures, telecommunications, wireless security, network packet analysis, cybersecurity, acquisition management, risk assessment, or security and counterintelligence (CI) investigations, or construction/facilities.
  
  
ENTRY/DEVELOPMENTAL
  
Entry is with a high school diploma or GED plus 4 years of relevant experience, or an Associate's degree plus 2 years of relevant experience, or relevant military experience and 2 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's degree and no experience.
  
  
FULL PERFORMANCE
  
Entry is with a high school diploma or GED plus 7 years of relevant experience, or an Associate's degree plus 5 years of relevant experience, or relevant military experience and 2 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's degree plus 3 years of relevant experience, or relevant security training plus 3 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree plus 1 year of relevant experience, or a Doctoral degree and no experience.

### **Education**

A degree in any field is acceptable. Military training must be at least 18 semester hours of training in security analysis.

### **Additional information**

Pay: Salary offers are based on candidates' education level and years of experience relevant to the position and also take into account information provided by the hiring manager/organization regarding the work level for the position.
  
  
Salary Range: $57,736 - $133,142 (Entry, Full Performance)
  
Salary range varies by location, work level, and relevant experience to the position.
  
  
Training will be provided based on the selectee's needs and experience.
  
  
Benefits: NSA offers a comprehensive benefits package.
  
  
Work Schedule: This is a full-time position, Monday - Friday, with basic 8hr/day work requirement between 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. (flexible).

jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

The Strategic Non‑Kinetic Effects Mission Division is seeking a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst with deep, cross-disciplinary expertise in networking, intelligence, and cybersecurity to design and deliver mission-critical solutions to the nation’s most complex challenges.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

The Department is currently seeking a senior-career cybersecurity professional to contribute individual technical expertise and support to a complex work program in support of critical national security objectives

Responsibilities include:

  

* Evaluating existing methodologies and developing recommendations for improved processes, tools, analytics, and infrastructure
* Identifying and leveraging capabilities from across MITRE that enable the sponsor to measurably increase mission impact
* Supporting intelligence collection operations by partnering closely with Sponsor leaders to apply human and technological capabilities that enable successful operational/mission outcomes
* Conveying technical, analytic, and organizational findings, recommendations, and approaches to senior decision makers and mission partners.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years’ experience; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
* Ability to work with others to solve challenging technical problems.
* Ability to think critically, work in group settings, and be proactive in pursuing research and problem solving.
* Experience with analyzing raw threat intelligence from one or more collection disciplines (ex. SIGINT, HUMINT, GEOINT, etc.) in support of operations and/or analysis.
* Understanding of computer networks and the OSI model, spanning hardware, software, and networking components, including how data flows and is secured across all layers.
* Experience with C5ISR-T analysis.
* Analytical experience related to technical subjects including telecommunications and network engineering.
* Experience in all-source intelligence, threat hunting, vulnerability analysis, network reverse engineering and network reconnaissance.
* Familiarity with intelligence community organizational and governance structures, and/or requirements processes.
* Experience with intelligence community analytic and requirements tools.
* *Must have an active* ***Top Secret/SCI*** *U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.*
* This position has an on-site requirement of 5 days a week on-site.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Intelligence community acquisition, planning, programming, budgeting and execution experience.
* Familiarity with the intent, capability and operations of top tier nation-station adversary threat groups targeting operational technology in critical infrastructure, space, or weapon systems.

**This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):**

Top Secret/SCI

**This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):**

Top Secret/SCI

**Salary compensation range and midpoint:**

$172,800 - $216,000 - $259,200 Annual

**Work Location Type:**

Onsite

**The Opportunity:**

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of an all-source analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing the intelligence community is no longer how to get more data, it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data, and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security.

You'll work with interagency teams to determine threats to DoD critical infrastructure, providing executive clients with threat briefings and mitigation opportunities. jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

**Job Description**

* Harness your expertise in shaping robust cybersecurity strategies and safeguarding critical assets. Your leadership will be pivotal in enhancing our resilience against evolving global cyber threats.

* As a Cybersecurity Intelligence Vice President at JPMorganChase within the Cybersecurity Operations group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding the firm's digital assets and infrastructure from cyber threats. You will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks while informing and influencing control measures across the organization. Your expertise in analyzing intelligence and developing innovative ways to track threat actors — combined with your ability to collaborate across diverse teams — will be essential in strengthening the firm's security posture. As a subject matter expert, you will contribute to strategic cybersecurity initiatives and continuously improve our threat detection and response capabilities, with direct impact on the firm's operations, fiscal management, public image, employee morale, and client relationships.

* **Job responsibilities**

* Implement proactive threat intelligence strategies using advanced analytics and emerging technologies to identify and mitigate risks, staying current with cybersecurity trends and sharing insights to implement best practices across the organization

* Leverage enterprise-authorized AI capabilities to accelerate threat intelligence synthesis and prioritization, validating outputs and handling data in accordance with sensitivity and security requirements

* Develop methods for detecting threat indicators within large data sets using data analysis tools and specialized query languages

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, sharing threat intelligence and best practices to achieve operational goals and improve cybersecurity operations

* Drive adoption of AI-assisted workflows to improve team productivity, ensuring all outputs are validated and aligned to security expectations

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess emerging threats and translate intelligence findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and technical teams

* Contribute to the continuous improvement of threat detection frameworks, playbooks, and response capabilities to address an evolving global threat landscape

* **Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on cybersecurity intelligence concepts and 5+ years applied experience

* Demonstrated experience in cybersecurity with a focus on threat intelligence, analysis, and risk mitigation

* Experience leveraging enterprise-authorized AI capabilities to support threat intelligence, tradecraft, and security research workflows, with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity

* Ability to review and validate intelligence findings and detection recommendations prior to implementation, escalating appropriately and adhering to security and data handling requirements

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including demonstrated experience preparing materials for senior executive audiences

* Proficiency with data analysis tools or specialized query languages used to identify threat indicators within large-scale data environments

* **Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Specific regional cybersecurity expertise and relevant language skills

* Experience working within or alongside a Security Operations Center (SOC) or Cyber Fusion Center environment

* Familiarity with industry-standard threat intelligence frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK or the Diamond Model

* Prior experience collaborating with government, law enforcement, or industry threat-sharing communities (e.g., ISACs)

* Advanced certifications in cybersecurity or threat intelligence (e.g., CISSP, CISM, GCIA, GCTI)

* Specific regional expertise and language skills preferred

jobs.title: Security Analyst II
jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Cyber Defense Investigations team is Microsoft's deep-dive investigative arm within Cyber Defense Operations (CDO). We investigate complex security incidents across Microsoft's cloud, identity, and supply chain environments, conduct root cause analysis, assess attacker activity, and drive actionable remediation and detection improvements.

As a **Security Analyst II,** you will lead investigations, craft quick detections, perform threat hunting, collaborate with engineering and response teams, and help improve Microsoft's ability to detect and respond to advanced threats.

Join Microsoft's CDI Escalations team and work at the forefront of cyber defense, investigating the most complex nation-state, supply chain, cloud, and identity-based attacks targeting Microsoft. Our team goes beyond traditional incident response, we combine deep investigations, threat hunting, intelligence operationalization, and cross-organizational collaboration to identify adversaries, drive platform-wide security improvements, and build defenses that prevent future attacks. You'll partner with leaders across MSTIC, GHOST, Detection Engineering, and service teams, leverage AI-powered investigation techniques, and directly influence Microsoft's security posture while solving some of the industry's hardest security challenges.

Starting February, 2026, Microsoft employees are expected to work from a designated Microsoft office at least three days a week if they live within 50 miles (U.S.) or 25 miles (non-U.S., country-specific) of that location. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Investigate complex security incidents involving cloud, identity, endpoint, and supply chain compromises.
* Ability to author detection at rapid speed.
* Conduct root cause analysis, impact assessment, and scope determination.
* Perform proactive threat hunting using Kusto (KQL), Defender, Entra ID, Azure, and other Microsoft telemetry sources.
* Partner with Detection Engineering, MSTIC, Service Teams, and Incident Response teams to contain and remediate threats.
* Develop investigative queries, hunting content, playbooks, and automation to improve operational efficiency.
* Translate investigation findings into actionable security improvements, detections, and process enhancements.
* Produce clear technical and executive-ready investigation reports.
* Mentor peers and contribute to investigative best practices and knowledge sharing.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 1+ year(s) experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat modeling, cyber security, anomaly detection, Security Operations Center (SOC) detection, threat analytics, security incident and event management (SIEM), information technology (IT), or operations incident response
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 2+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat modeling, cyber security, anomaly detection, Security Operations Center (SOC) detection, threat analytics, security incident and event management (SIEM), information technology (IT), or operations incident response
OR equivalent experience.  



**Other Requirements:**

Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Sentinel or other detection authoring tools,
* Experience investigating security incidents in cloud or enterprise environments.
* Experience using KQL/Kusto, SQL, or similar query languages for log analysis.
* Understanding of attacker techniques, cloud security, identity security, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Strong analytical and communication skills.
* Experience with Microsoft security platforms, including Defender XDR, Sentinel, Entra ID, and Azure security telemetry.
* Experience investigating identity-based attacks, credential theft, OAuth abuse, or cloud compromise scenarios.
* Experience with supply chain security investigations involving GitHub, npm, or software package ecosystems.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted investigation workflows and security automation.
* Security certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, CISSP, GCFE, OSCP, or equivalent.

jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst, Global Security Intelligence
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Join an innovative team that delivers tailored intelligence products and services to protect our customers and business operations. In this role, you will produce rapid risk assessments, conduct open-source intelligence (OSINT) investigations, and translate complex customer requirements into scalable, actionable solutions. You will leverage OSINT and tradecraft to uncover emerging threats, and develop strategic products that help customers anticipate risks and look around the corner.  
  
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that demands critical thinking, deep-dive analysis, and the ability to manage competing priorities with exceptional attention to detail. They bring a genuine passion for delighting customers, collaborating across teams, and continuously raising the bar - always seeking opportunities to refine processes, close gaps, and deliver more impactful products.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data with a strong understanding and application of analytical techniques.
* Proactively identify and analyze relevant threats and trends and produce written strategic analysis, oral briefs, and tactical/investigative assessments in a cohesive and concise format to serve customers across business lines.
* Engage with internal customers to understand their priorities and translate the requirements into solutions.
* Identify new solutions, methodologies, including using AI, to help improve information collection and reporting. Including the creation of maps or other visuals and tools to support the team's deliverables.
* Perform thorough quick-turn and deep dive open-source investigations and monitoring.
* Support business continuity, crisis, and security management teams, including as needed outside typical work hours during security incidents and emerging crises.

  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why Amazon Security?  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  
  
Training & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in Incident Management, Threat Management, Corporate Investigations, Law Enforcement, Security Operations, Crisis Management or a related field
* Can show strong verbal and written communication skills
* Experience handling confidential information
* Experience with open source investigation techniques
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree or equivalent, or experience in a professional field or military
* OSINT certifications or equivalent training
* Experience with the intelligence cycle and Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIR) development
* 3+ years in intelligence, investigative, or analytical discipline

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. We are Sparksoft!

jobs.title: Project Manager, Global Functions
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**

You’re a strategic and collaborative project management professional with a passion for delivering enterprise-wide initiatives and ensuring business adoption for a lasting impact. As a Project Manager at WSP, you’ll lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive organizational change and operational excellence. You’ll work closely with Program Management Office and business partners and functional leads to enable execution and adoption of the transformation roadmap.

**Where Your Ideas Matter –** If you're ready to take your career to the next level, this role offers the chance to work on projects that push boundaries and impact communities worldwide. Be part of a team that values your ideas, expertise, and growth.

**Your Impact**

**Strategic Project Delivery**  
Lead the planning and execution of high-impact, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across corporate functions such as HR, Legal, Procurement, Marketing & Communications, and Finance. Ensure alignment with organizational goals and stakeholder expectations.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**  
Partner with functional leads and business and technology stakeholders to align on project objectives, confirm scope and success metrics. Foster collaboration across matrixed teams to drive accountability and shared ownership.

**Organizational Design and Change Enablement**  
Enable stakeholder adoption and ensure solutions are embedded into day-to-day operations to realize intended business benefits.

**Governance and Reporting**  
Establish and maintain governance structures, reporting frameworks, and communication plans that support transparency and informed decision-making. Prepare updates and support steering committee discussions.

**Risk and Issue Management**  
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues. Proactively escalate challenges and recommend solutions to maintain momentum and delivery confidence.

**Tool and Process Optimization**  
Leverage tools such as Smartsheet, SharePoint, and PowerPoint to manage project plans, track deliverables, and communicate progress. Continuously seek opportunities to improve project delivery processes and tools.

**The skills that set you apart**

7+ years of experience managing complex, multi-functional projects in financial services, engineering, or public sector environments..

Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-functional projects with a strategic lens and a focus on measurable outcomes.

Skilled in building trust and alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, including senior leadership, functional leads, and delivery teams.

Experience in assessing stakeholder impact and enabling adoption, with familiarity in ADKAR, Prosci, Lean Change frameworks or similar.

Adept at embedding governance structures and reporting mechanisms that drive accountability and transparency.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling narratives.

PMP certification required; Agile Certified Practitioner is an asset. Proficiency in Smartsheet, SharePoint, and PowerPoint.

***Make Your Mark with WSP***

*If you're driven by purpose and impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career with us.*

**#LI-SB1**

  

At **WSP** , we exist to shape communities to advance humanity.
  
  
It’s why we bring people together who are wired to solve complex challenges - engineers, scientists, advisors, and technical experts who are driven by a common passion - to redefine what’s possible and shape what comes next. We are Visioneers.
  
  
As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, we partner with clients across transportation, infrastructure, environment, buildings, energy, water, mining and metals. We pair deep local knowledge with global insights to pioneer solutions designed to leave a lasting, positive impact.
  
  
At **WSP** , you’ll join a community of brilliant minds that push boundaries every day - applying deep expertise and fuelling innovation to help create a more connected and resilient future. Here, your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and you are encouraged to bring your authentic self to work. We empower our people to collaborate across disciplines, challenge the status quo, and shape a career with purpose.
  
  
Join us.

jobs.title: GSOC Regional Program Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience implementing security resilience programs impacting teams across multiple regions.
* Experience with multidisciplinary program management in an organization.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Ability to identify, build, improve, or optimize relevant business processes.
* Ability to lead projects by navigating priorities, measurable objectives, dependencies, planning, resourcing, scheduling, budgeting, implementation and subsequent monitoring.
* Ability to analyse business objectives and strategies by proactively identifying impactful opportunities or gaps in systems and workflows.
* High ethical standards with demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information.
* Excellent judgement, discretion and diplomacy skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive incidents and crises, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team. As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.

The Global Security Operations Center is GSRS’s 24/7 ecosystem for intake, triage, management and escalation of physical security incidents and threats.

As a GSOC Program Manager, you act as the focal point and principal enabler of program delivery at the regional level. This role supports the GSOC Senior Program Manager (SPgM) with the delivery of multidisciplinary projects and programs spanning people, processes and technology. As a critical enabler of the GSOC strategy and vision, the GSOC Program Manager must leverage a broad skill set across multiple complex workstreams while acting as a strategic partner to key stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support complex cross-functional programs of work, leading both discreet projects and the local implementation of global initiatives as directed by the GSOC Senior Program Manager.
* Drive operational excellence across programs through maturing project documentation, standardizing monitoring of key performance indicators, and effective knowledge management.
* Maintain and develop cross-functional partnerships with key GSRS and external stakeholders, acting as regional representatives for GSOC programs.
* Act as a liaison to partners and support the Regional SOC Manager to improve operational delivery through effective change management, communications and stakeholder engagement.
* Contribute to the GSRS mission to protect, sustain and enable Google’s ability to thrive. Cultivate team norms that foster psychological safety and mutual respect.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce is the leading AI CRM, empowering companies to drive customer success through the combination of human expertise and autonomous agents. We are looking for innovators passionate about transforming businesses through AI and leading workforce transformation in the agentic era. Agentforce is the future of AI, and we are looking for experienced professionals to help our customers navigate this next frontier.

  
  

**About the Role**

  

The Life Sciences Program Executive (PE) is a senior, client-facing individual contributor within the Global Life Sciences Acceleration Hub at Salesforce. In this role, you will expertly lead multi-workstream transformations, manage strategic accounts, and oversee complex enterprise implementations where precision is paramount and outcomes have direct C-suite visibility.

You will act as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams, fully owning the end-to-end program P&L, leading the Salesforce project team, and governing the budget. Sitting at the helm of AI and Agentforce transformations, you will help Life Sciences organizations accelerate drug commercialization, streamline field engagement, and modernize clinical and commercial operations. jobs.title: Child Safety Digital Investigations Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Digital Investigations Team work with social media platforms, governments, and non-profit organisations to help them understand and navigate digital threats. Our highly skilled team work at the cutting edge of digital threat and online harm, helping clients detect and respond. We use innovative technology and have a deep understanding of everything related to social media and online infrastructure. We're not just about the platforms themselves, but also about the behaviours and intent of those who use them for adversarial outcomes, and those they target.

As an analyst working on child safety, you'll identify and investigate threats to children online. These range from grooming and exploitation to the involvement of minors in online harm networks and violent extremism. Your work will help our clients act before harm spreads and has a direct, real-world impact.

### **What you'll be doing**

* Identifying and tracking online threats involving child sexual abuse material (CSAM), grooming and child exploitation.
* Researching the involvement of minors in sadistic online harm networks and nihilistic violent extremism (NVE), including coercion, extortion and the encouragement of self-harm.
* Map and assess the novel TTPs of bad actors, such as use of language, coded terms and methods of evasion.
* Identify emerging risks and subjects of interest ahead of our clients.
* Deploy our in-house technical capability on investigations.
* Produce concise and contextualised threat reporting.
* Supporting client engagement, interaction and presenting intelligence back to clients

### **On day one you will bring**

* Experience in online research, digital investigations, open-source intelligence (OSINT).
* Knowledge and experience of online child safety, ideally with depth in child endangerment, sadistic online harm or youth radicalisation.
* The mindset of an investigative journalist, a curious and persistent investigator.
* The ability to write clear and concise threat assessments.
* A background in research, safeguarding or intelligence role, whether in law enforcement, journalism, NGOs or tech platforms.
* A resilient, discreet approach to sensitive work, as you will be exposed to challenging material and will need to strictly adhere to protocols.

#### **Why join us?**

* Dedicated wellbeing support, through a specialist provider, that includes regular psychological screening and specialist counselling.
* A diverse and challenging workload across multiple complex projects and investigations.
* A collaborative and supportive team at the forefront of this sphere.
* Clients who get what we do and offer us genuine innovation opportunities.
* A meritocratic environment that promotes career progression and development
* Niche training to support niche skill sets.
* Hybrid working which allows you to strike the perfect work-life balance.

#### **Our Benefits**

* When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive range of employee benefits, including:
* Performance related bonus
* Life Assurance – 4x your annual salary
* £45 Monthly cost of living voucher
* 25 days’ annual leave plus all standard UK public holidays.
* Vitality Healthcare
* Annual eye care support
* Cycle to Work Scheme
* Subsidised gym membership
* Winter flu vaccination
* Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at PGI

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at PGI**

As a British company which operates internationally, we draw strength from the diversity of our people. Without our diverse team, we couldn’t do the work we do. We are involved in projects across 80+ geographies, our people speak 25+ languages and come from a variety of backgrounds. By hiring and cultivating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, we can uphold values that enable every member of the team to thrive, while delivering novel solutions to novel problems.

**Accessibility at PGI**

Every individual has different requirements, so we are committed to implementing reasonable adjustments to mitigate physical and non-physical barriers in the workplace.

We strive to make the recruitment process as accessible as possible, but if you have any questions or concerns, please get in touch.

***Please note:*** *We are not accepting applications or speculative profiles from any recruitment agencies. If we require additional resource, we will reach out to you.*

Our Data, Digital and Technology team are leading the way in innovations that will make our airport more efficient, resilient and competitive in an increasingly digital marketplace, as well as keeping Heathrow safe and secure.

Every day will test your skills and give you the opportunity to make your mark. We're constantly looking for new ways to help Heathrow transform and grow, responding to the changing needs of passengers, colleagues and partner businesses.

It means the chance to work on a huge variety of inspiring projects and to develop in lots of exciting directions. Our team covers technology, cyber defence, data and digital, offering one-of-a-kind careers you won't find anywhere else.

  

As a Business Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use information to improve passenger experience, streamline operations, and support our sustainability goals. You’ll work within a collaborative team closely partnering with Product Managers, Product Owners, business stakeholders and others across the airport to turn complex data into actionable intelligence. Your work will help Heathrow make smarter, faster, and more customer focused decisions every day.

  

* Working directly with Product Owners and business teams to understand their processes and identify opportunities for data driven improvement.
* Analysing Finance and HR data to uncover insights that inform product and process enhancements.
* Working collaboratively across the business to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and supports strategic goals.
* Translating analytical findings into clear recommendations that support Heathrow’s mission to deliver outstanding passenger experiences.
* Ensuring compliance with relevant governance, risk management and regulatory requirements.

  

* Strong understanding of business processes and how data supports decision-making.

* Ability to interpret and communicate complex data insights to non-technical audiences.

* Collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.

**Ideally you will have**

* Background in data analytics, business intelligence, or product analysis.
* Experience in aviation or large-scale operational environments.

  

There’s something so special about working at the world’s most iconic airport. Its sights. Its sounds. Its constant air of excitement. Heathrow is an amazing backdrop to a career filled with unique opportunities.

Every day, you’ll discover a world full of fresh possibilities and end the day buzzing with stories to tell, as you encounter people from all cultures, nationalities and experiences. A world full of pride for what we do and no end of exciting career prospects to explore.

It brings out the best in all of us. And inspires everyone to deliver on our ambitious plans. Together, we’re working to welcome millions more passengers while ensuring aviation can continue to be a force for good by leading global efforts in sustainability.

Join us on that journey and we'll help you achieve your ambitions too. Supporting you to learn, encouraging you to be yourself, backing you to achieve more than you might ever have imagined. Because there’s no place like Heathrow.

With family friendly policies, access to private health insurance and a wide range of wellbeing tools, we’ll support you to be at your best inside and outside work. **Sustainable Travel to work**

**Equal Opportunities**

As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage applications from all. With five diversity networks, we champion inclusivity and celebrate individuality.

**Job Description:**

DXC Technology is committed to building diverse, inclusive teams. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and particularly encourage interest from women, underrepresented groups, and neurodivergent candidates. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the hiring process and are dedicated to creating a supportive, accessible environment for everyone.

  

**Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst**

**Location: Farnborough (onsite 5 days per week)**

  

**Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations.**

  

The Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, integrity, and actionability of hardware asset data across the full asset lifecycle — from procurement through deployment, operation, redeployment, and disposal. This role is the data backbone of the Hardware Asset Management function, providing the trusted information foundation upon which financial, contractual, compliance, and operational decisions are made.

Aligned to ITAM (IT Asset Management) industry standards and frameworks — including ISO 19770, IAITAM best practices, and ITIL 4 IT Asset Management practice — the HAM Data Analyst ensures that hardware asset records are accurate, reconciled, auditable, and continuously improved. The role operates at the intersection of asset management, configuration management, procurement, finance, operations, and compliance.

This is not a passive data entry role. The HAM Data Analyst is expected to proactively identify data quality issues, reconcile discrepancies between data sources, challenge inaccurate records, and drive the data maturity of the hardware asset estate to a level that supports confident decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Hardware Asset Data Management & Quality

* Own and maintain the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of hardware asset records within the ITAM tool, CMDB, and associated asset repositories.
* Perform regular data quality audits across hardware asset records — identifying gaps, duplicates, orphaned records, misclassifications, and stale data.
* Reconcile hardware asset data across multiple sources including ITAM tools, CMDB, procurement systems, financial systems, discovery tools, and physical audit results.
* Develop and maintain data quality KPIs and dashboards to provide visibility of asset data health to stakeholders and leadership.
* Enforce data standards, naming conventions, classification taxonomies, and mandatory field requirements for hardware asset records.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, escalating systemic issues to process owners and data source owners.
* Ensure asset records reflect the current state of the physical estate — not just what was originally procured or deployed.

Hardware Asset Lifecycle Data Tracking

* Maintain accurate records across all stages of the hardware asset lifecycle:

**Lifecycle Stage**

**Data Analyst Responsibility**

Request & Procurement

Validate asset data at point of purchase order and goods receipt; ensure procurement records feed accurately into the asset register

Receipt & Warehousing

Confirm asset receipt records match purchase orders; validate serial numbers, models, and quantities

Deployment & Installation

Ensure deployment records are updated with location, assigned user, CI relationships, and operational status

In-Service / Operational

Maintain current records for location, ownership, status, warranty, support contracts, and configuration changes

Move / Add / Change (MAC)

Track and update records for asset moves, additions, changes, and redeployments

Redeployment & Reuse

Update records when assets are recovered, refurbished, and redeployed — ensuring full chain of custody

Decommission & Disposal

Validate disposal records including data sanitisation evidence, environmental compliance, and certificate of destruction

End of Life / End of Support

Track and report on assets approaching or past vendor end-of-life (EOL) and end-of-support (EOS) dates

Discovery & Reconciliation

* Reconcile hardware asset data between the authoritative asset register and automated discovery tool outputs to identify:
  + **Ghost assets** — assets in the register but not found by discovery (potentially lost, stolen, decommissioned, or misrecorded).
  + **Unmanaged assets** — assets found by discovery but not in the register (potentially unauthorised, shadow IT, or missed intake).
  + **Data mismatches** — discrepancies in serial numbers, models, locations, ownership, or status between sources.
* Produce regular reconciliation reports and drive resolution of discrepancies with operational and support teams.
* Work with infrastructure, network, and endpoint teams to improve discovery coverage and data accuracy.
* Support physical audit and stock verification activities by providing data extracts, variance analysis, and reconciliation support.

Reporting & Analytics

* Produce regular and ad-hoc hardware asset reports and dashboards covering:
  + Asset inventory by type, location, business unit, status, and lifecycle stage.
  + Data quality metrics (completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency).
  + Warranty and support contract coverage and expiry.
  + End-of-life and end-of-support exposure.
  + Asset utilisation and underutilisation indicators.
  + Cost of ownership and depreciation tracking (in collaboration with finance).
  + Disposal and environmental compliance status.
  + Reconciliation status and variance trends.
* Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to the HAM Manager, ITAM Manager, and senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Hard FM Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Location: Darrent Valley Hospital, Kent, DA2 8DA**  
**Salary: £62,742 to £69,133 per annum, dependant on experience plus excellent benefits**  
**Schedule: Full time, permanent**

**Ready to impact a better future?**

As a Hard FM Project Manager at Darrent Valley Hospital, you’ll lead the safe, compliant and effective delivery of technically complex Hard FM projects from early identification, survey and scoping through to procurement, construction, commissioning and handover. You’ll play a key role in translating operational requirements and technical asset information into robust project documentation, specifications and delivery plans that support safe, resilient healthcare environments.

Working closely with clinical teams, estates colleagues, technical specialists and contractors, you’ll ensure projects are delivered with a clear audit trail, strong governance and full compliance with CDM2015, statutory duties, Serco requirements and relevant healthcare engineering standards.

**What you’ll do as a Hard FM Project Manager**  
You’ll be entrusted to:

* Manage multiple Hard FM projects and small programmes, ensuring delivery within agreed budgets, timescales, quality standards and governance requirements.
* Develop clear service user briefs, feasibility reports, business cases, project initiation documents and approval papers that support informed decision-making.
* Interpret mechanical, electrical and water systems information, including surveys, asset condition data, technical reports, drawings, compliance records and specialist recommendations.
* Build detailed technical scopes, specifications, schedules of work and tender documentation that accurately define the required outcome, standards, constraints and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure all projects are planned and delivered in accordance with CDM2015 legislation, including appropriate consideration of client duties, designer and contractor responsibilities, pre-construction information, construction phase plans, RAMS and health and safety files.
* Maintain robust project documentation, version control, approvals, decisions, change records and audit trails throughout the project lifecycle.
* Co-ordinate architects, consultants, engineers, ICT specialists, Authorised Persons, contractors and other professionals to ensure technical, operational and compliance requirements are met.
* Oversee contractor submissions, qualifications, permits, RAMS, commissioning records and handover information, ensuring safe systems of work and appropriate evidence of compliance.
* Manage stakeholder relationships with clinical and non-clinical colleagues, customer representatives, contractors, suppliers and internal Serco teams.
* Support commissioning, handover, training and post-contract activities, ensuring completed works are accepted by user departments and internal support teams.
* Prepare project reports, cost updates, risk information and programme updates for project boards, programme reviews and governance meetings.
* Work collaboratively with Serco colleagues across Fire, Energy, ICT, Procurement, Health and Safety, Estates and operational teams to resolve issues and maintain project momentum.

**Does this sound like you?**  
You’ll be a great fit for this role if you have:

* Proven experience delivering Hard FM, estates, lifecycle or capital projects in a technically regulated environment, ideally within healthcare, hospitals, PFI/PPP or critical infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of CDM2015 legislation and the ability to apply it practically across project planning, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover.
* Experience producing and controlling project documentation, including scopes, specifications, tender packs, approvals, reports, risk registers, change records, handover packs and audit evidence.
* The ability to review, interpret and challenge technical information relating to mechanical systems, water safety and electrical infrastructure, drawing on specialist support where required.
* Confidence in developing detailed technical specifications and scopes of work that are clear, commercially robust and suitable for procurement and contractor delivery.
* Good understanding of statutory and non-statutory compliance requirements relevant to Hard FM services, healthcare estates and safe project delivery.
* Experience managing budgets, programmes, contractors, risks, stakeholders and contract administration activities.
* Strong communication, planning and organisational skills, with the ability to engage confidently with technical specialists, operational teams and senior stakeholders.
* Experience using CAFM systems, Microsoft Office tools and project reporting systems to maintain accurate records and support governance.
* A relevant technical, construction, engineering, project management or facilities management qualification, or equivalent experience supported by continued professional development.

**Vetting and checks:**  
A Standard DBS check will be carried out for this position. This includes spent and unspent convictions, cautions, reprimands, and warnings as permitted under the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act. An Occupational Health Questionnaire will also be completed so we can ensure you have the necessary support to perform your duties.

**Discover all you need to keep growing**  
We’re one of the top 1% of international employers, so you can have confidence you’ll be part of a highly supportive culture with leaders you can count on to help you achieve your goals. From mentoring and training to our focus on internal progression, we’re proud to offer clear development opportunities – and the support and tools to help you seize them.

jobs.title: NEC Project Manager
jobs.description:
**6 Month Contract With A Local Authority**
-------------------------------------------

  
  

**Job Purpose**

To lead the end-to-end delivery of NEC system implementations and enhancement programmes across multiple business-critical workstreams, ensuring successful deployment, integration and adoption of NEC solutions throughout the organisation.

The postholder will take full ownership of project delivery from initiation through to go-live, managing project governance, technical dependencies, stakeholder engagement, budgets, resources and risk management. Working closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, suppliers and implementation partners, the role will ensure NEC modules are delivered on time, within scope and aligned to organisational objectives.

The NEC Project Manager will provide leadership across complex system implementation projects, ensuring robust governance, operational readiness and successful business outcomes.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of NEC system projects and module implementations.
* Manage multiple concurrent NEC workstreams and implementation programmes.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans and delivery roadmaps.
* Coordinate NEC module deployment activities from initiation through to go-live.
* Manage cross-module dependencies, integration requirements and critical delivery paths.
* Work closely with technical leads, solution architects and business stakeholders to ensure successful implementation outcomes.
* Ensure system configurations align with business requirements and operational needs.
* Implement and manage project governance frameworks and reporting structures.
* Maintain and monitor project plans, milestones, budgets, resources and timelines.
* Lead project change control processes and assess the impact of scope changes.
* Manage and maintain RAIDD logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies and Decisions).
* Identify, mitigate and escalate project risks and delivery challenges.
* Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, suppliers and technical teams.
* Facilitate project meetings, workshops and governance boards.
* Provide regular performance updates, status reports and executive briefings.
* Lead cross-functional teams and drive accountability for project deliverables.
* Coordinate internal departments, external vendors and implementation partners.
* Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT), operational readiness assessments and deployment activities.
* Ensure all testing, validation and sign-off requirements are completed prior to release.
* Monitor supplier performance and contractual deliverables against agreed service levels.
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation and financial controls.
* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with corporate governance, procurement and information security requirements.
* Support business change, user adoption and transition to operational support teams.
Drive continuous improvement and lessons learned activities following project completion.  

  
  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Essential**

* Significant experience delivering NEC system implementations and projects.
* Proven experience managing multiple NEC modules simultaneously.
* Demonstrable experience leading end-to-end system delivery programmes.
* Strong project management experience within complex organisational environments.
* Experience managing:
  + Project Governance
  + Change Control
  + Risk Management
  + Stakeholder Engagement
  + System Integration
  + Supplier Management
* Experience managing technical and business workstreams concurrently.
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and best practice.
* Experience maintaining and managing RAIDD logs.
* Experience overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and go-live activities.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive project delivery.
* Experience managing budgets, resources and programme reporting.
* Excellent organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within challenging deadlines.

### **Desirable**

* PRINCE2, MSP, Agile, APM or equivalent Project Management qualification.
* Experience within Local Government or Public Sector environments.
* Experience managing NEC Housing, Revenues & Benefits, Asset Management, Housing Repairs or other NEC software solutions.
* Knowledge of system migrations, integrations and business transformation programmes.
* Experience managing software vendors and implementation partners.
Knowledge of business change and service transformation methodologies.  

  
  

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* **Location:** Hackney
* **Hours Per Week:** 36 Hours
* **Payment Frequency:** Bi-Weekly Payments

**Location:** City of London - onsite 3 days per week
  
**Duration:** Fixed Term Contract - 6 months
  
**Salary:** Dependent on experience
  
**Start:** ASAP
  
  
At Pace, our consultants genuinely care about the impact our work has on our customers and their customers alike. We are ‘problem solvers’ who call on our collective experience, knowledge and skills to support customers to access benefits early.
  
  
Our mission is to create environments that thrive for our customers; we enable this by providing transformation, process optimisation, and automation services, all with the aim of enabling our customers to harness human autonomy.
  
  
We are reimagining how transformation services are delivered, taking a human-centred approach, and our work is having a material impact on people's lives. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Role:**  
  
Supporting one of our Legal Services customers in Central London, you will join us as an experienced Project Manager to lead two high-profile, technology-enabled Finance initiatives.
  
  
The role will take ownership of a global E-Invoicing project, ensuring that statutory inbound and outbound invoicing requirements are delivered across in-scope offices within mandatory deadlines. It will also support the Revenue Life Cycle Technology and Tools programme, delivering solutions that help Finance teams reduce billing costs and cycle times.
  
  
This is a complex, cross-functional delivery role involving Technology, Finance, Tax, local offices, SAP programme teams and third-party vendors. The successful candidate will bring strong governance, structured planning and the ability to maintain momentum across multiple regional implementations.
  
  
You will be an experienced Project Manager who combines structured delivery discipline with sound, pragmatic judgement. Comfortable operating across business and technology teams, you will be able to create clarity in a complex environment, build alignment among senior stakeholders and suppliers, and keep regional delivery on track against mandatory statutory deadlines.
  
  
**Responsibilities of the Project Manager include:**  

* Owning and maintaining the integrated E-Invoicing project plan, covering regional milestones, statutory deadlines, testing, deployment and post-go-live warranty periods.
* Coordinating Technology, Finance, Tax, local office, vendor and SAP programme workstreams.
* Managing project governance, including Project Board reporting, RAID management, approvals, change control, escalations and exception reporting.
* Tracking scope, budget and resources, ensuring that impacts on timescales, requirements and cost are assessed and managed through the appropriate governance routes.
* Driving requirements confirmation, design approval, build readiness, test planning, UAT, deployment readiness and service transition.
* Working with Finance and change stakeholders to assess process impacts and coordinate communications, training and operational readiness.
* Managing engagement with external vendors, including delivery coordination, statement-of-work activity and issue escalation.
* Maintaining complete, controlled and audit-ready project documentation that can be reused for future implementations.
* Supporting the delivery and acceptance of technology-enabled tools for the Revenue Life Cycle programme

* Proven experience of managing complex, technology-enabled business change projects involving multiple business, technology and supplier stakeholders.
* Strong project planning, governance, financial tracking, RAID management and senior stakeholder reporting capability.
* Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills.
* The ability to translate technical, regulatory and process considerations into clear delivery actions.
* Experience coordinating requirements, design approval, testing, UAT, deployment readiness and service transition across multiple implementations.
* Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain documentation suitable for audit and governance.
* A pragmatic delivery style and the confidence to maintain momentum against fixed deadlines while managing scope, budget, risk and dependencies.
* Focused on Delivery: A practical approach to maintaining momentum, following through on agreed actions and ensuring established priorities are delivered consistently.
* Strong Multitasker: The ability to manage multiple governance cycles, reporting requirements and portfolio activities simultaneously.
* Confident Communicator: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Project Managers, senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Proactive Ownership: A willingness to take responsibility for the accuracy, timeliness and quality of portfolio information.
* Attention to Detail: Strong organisational skills and a disciplined approach to maintaining records, tracking actions and managing documentation.
* Team Player: A collaborative working style and a genuine interest in supporting Project Managers and colleagues to achieve shared outcomes.
