jobs.description:
Role: Lead Commercial Analyst
  
Location: Hybrid (3 days per week Clapham Junction, 2 days remote)
  
  
**We’re The Gym Group...**

  

We’re one of the UK’s leading fitness businesses. With more than one million members, 265+ gyms and ambitious plans to keep growing, we’re the UK’s second-largest gym operator by membership and the fourth largest in Europe.

  

Our mission is simple: to break down barriers to fitness for all. We’re large enough to make a meaningful difference, but agile enough for individuals to influence how we grow. Technology, data and new ideas play a central role - and you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, challenge how things are done and see the impact of your work.

  

Just as importantly, we’re a people-first business where everyone is encouraged to be themselves. We’ve been named one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work and awarded Investors in People Gold, alongside a host of other awards recognising our culture and our people.
  
  
**About the role...**  
  
This is a senior analytics role with real influence - you will partner directly with our Product and Retention teams to shape strategic decisions, design how we measure success and identify the commercial opportunities that help us keep our members and grow the business. If you are an analyst who wants to move beyond reporting and genuinely drive outcomes, this is the role for y ou.  
  
  
  
**What you'll be doing...**

  

* Partnering with Product and Retention teams to identify, size and evaluate strategic initiatives using data
* Designing measurement frameworks that define success before initiatives go live and evaluating outcomes after launch
* Leading payment performance reporting and identifying opportunities to improve payment success and reduce member churn
* Delivering complex end-to-end analytical projects independently, from problem definition through to recommendation
* Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Marketing, Operations and Technology and influencing business priorities
* Communicating findings clearly through strong data visualisation and storytelling tailored to senior, non-technical audiences
* Supporting and mentoring analysts in the team, helping raise standards and ways of working across the function
Identifying opportunities to improve analytics through automation, new tools and AI  

  

**About you...**

  

* Advanced SQL skills and the ability to independently extract and analyse complex datasets
* Proven experience leading analytical projects end-to-end in a commercial or consumer-facing environment
* Strong commercial judgement and the ability to translate data into business decisions
* Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders
* Experience designing measurement frameworks and evaluating business or product performance
A proactive, curious approach - someone who spots opportunities, challenges assumptions and drives improvement  

  

**Need assistance?**

If you have a disability or condition that makes it difficult for you to complete your application online please email your cv to recruitment@thegymgroup.com or alternatively call the TGG Recruitment team on 0203 319 4838 and someone will be more than happy to support you. We also want to put it out there that we actively encourage applications from a diverse demographic and we are passionate about your culture and value alignment. We want this to be a match that works for you as much as for us!

**\*Please note that we may close the application window early if we receive high levels of interest. If you're interested in applying please do so asap!**

*Your application may be reviewed by an AI tool to help assess your suitability based on the information you provide. Automated decision-making is never used - every application is reviewed and all decisions, including whether to progress your application, are made exclusively by a member of our recruitment team. Your data will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and UK GDPR*

jobs.title: Analyst, Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a Business Operations Analyst to support and improve critical business operations across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Billing, and Data teams. This role will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy of Salesforce order and merchant data, supporting downstream billing processes, improving operational workflows, and driving scalable business process improvements. The role may also support broader business operations, governance, reporting, and priority initiatives across Visa Direct, as required.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in working with cross-functional teams to improve sales processes, pricing controls, data quality, and revenue operations. This individual will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders and operational teams to ensure accurate order management, efficient processes, and strong alignment across systems. This role offers broad exposure across business operations, governance, reporting, analytics, process improvement, and priority initiatives within Visa Direct.

Key Responsibilities:

* Manage Salesforce order maintenance activities, ensuring that client merchant records, sales order items, pricing structures, and related data are accurate and complete for downstream billing and revenue processes.
* Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Billing, Data, and other operational teams to validate deal structures, pricing accuracy, and system controls.
* Support the Global Visa Direct BPO Head and designated team members with the timely preparation of required materials, coordination of key deliverables, execution of assigned business priorities, follow-through on agreed actions and effective response to time-sensitive business requests. Maintain visibility into decisions, owners, milestones, risks, and dependencies and proactively raise issues that may impact delivery. Provide analytical, operational, reporting, co-ordination, and project support across evolving business priorities as required.

* Monitor sales and marketing data to identify trends, reporting gaps, process breakdowns, and data quality issues that may impact business performance or operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing business processes and partner with management to scope, prioritize, and execute operational improvement projects.
* Create, document, and drive adoption of new business and system processes that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual work, and enhance data integrity.
* Serve as a cross-functional liaison across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, operational teams and other business stakeholders to drive alignment and collaboration.
* Support the development and implementation of scalable controls across business systems to ensure pricing validity, order accuracy, and billing readiness.
* Analyze operational workflows and recommend forward-thinking solutions that improve sales processes, support accurate revenue recognition, and reduce operational risk.
* Partner with stakeholders to define business requirements, assess process impacts, and support change management for new tools, workflows, and system enhancements.
* Prepare insights, reporting, and recommendations for leadership to support business decisions and operational improvements.
* Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement through process simplification, automation, AI-enabled productivity, and reporting modernization.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

  

* Previous experience in business operations, sales operations, revenue operations, order management, billing operations, or a related analytical role.
* Hands-on experience working with Salesforce, particularly in order management, account records, sales order items, pricing, or opportunity/order workflows.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, AI tools, including data analysis, reconciliation, structured reporting, and preparation of leadership-ready materials. A good understanding of sales operations processes, deal structures, pricing validation, and downstream billing or revenue recognition impacts.
* Proven ability to identify process improvement opportunities and support implementation of scalable operational solutions.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Billing, Data and other business or operational teams.
* Ability to translate business needs into concise and clear process requirements, controls, actionable recommendations and practical operational workflows.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of new processes. Ability to explain complex business concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
**Mortgage Operations Analyst (German Speaking)**

Location: Zurich Switzerland

Type: Full-time

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Mortgage Operations Analyst to join our Credit Operations team. The ideal candidate will play a key role in ensuring the accurate and timely processing of mortgage loans through to closing. This role requires excellent organizational skills, in-depth knowledge of mortgage processing procedures, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Review and process mortgage loan applications to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate and communicate with loan officers, underwriters, title companies, appraisers, and borrowers to collect required documentation.
* Verify borrower information including income, assets, employment, and credit.
* Maintain loan processing pipeline and track progress to ensure on-time closings.
* Perform quality control checks to ensure loan files meet all investor and compliance guidelines.
* Identify and resolve processing issues or delays proactively.
* Input and update data in loan origination systems and other platforms as needed.
* Ensure compliance with FINMA and other relevant mortgage regulations.
* Provide regular status updates to borrowers and stakeholders.
* Support audit requests and post-closing reviews.

**Eligibility Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor's degree in business, finance, or related field preferred.
* 1+ years of mortgage processing or related mortgage operations experience, here in Switzerland
* Good knowledge of Swiss mortgage products (fixed, SARON, etc) processing procedures, and regulatory guidelines.
* Experience in credit processing systems (e.g. Avaloq, Finnova).
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines.
* Familiarity with compliance standards (e.g. FINMA)
* Notary designation is a plus.

jobs.title: Associate Research Analyst
jobs.description:
PRIMARY PURPOSE
  
These positions are located at NAS Pt. Mugu, CA and Edwards AFB, CA.
  
CNA is hiring for Associate Research Analysts to join their Advanced Technology Assessment (ATA) Division. Staff at this level will provide research, analytical, and technical support on a range of projects.
  
  
As part of the Department of the Navy’s Federally Funded Research and Development Center (FFRDC), CNA’s Advanced Technology Assessments (ATA) division provides analysis that evaluates the military utility and efficacy of emerging defense technologies and prototypes, operational test and evaluation of DoD programs of record, and tactics development and resourcing decisions for existing naval aircraft.
  
  
Analyses from ATA help the Navy make data-informed resourcing, training, and modernization decisions for new and existing defense technologies, with a focus on naval aircraft. Our research supports defense innovation programs to ensure operational effectiveness and lethality and to maintain the technological superiority of US military forces. ATA also contributes independent analyses to the testing of new aviation systems and the development of tactics to optimize the effectiveness of existing aircraft.
  
CNA fosters an inclusive culture that values diverse backgrounds and perspectives.
  
Our flexible and engaging work environment encourages iterative and creative collaboration at every stage of the problem solving process. Our employees are committed to helping clients develop effective solutions to better manage their programs through scientific, data-driven approaches. We are looking for creative and innovative individuals to help carry out our mission.
  
  
JOB DESCRIPTION AND/OR DUTIES
  
1. Under close supervision, conducts research and analysis that meets CNA’s quality standards on focused, structured questions. Can effectively apply standard, routine, and well-established analytic methodologies. With minimal direction and supervision, routinely produces analysis that is logical and traceable as well as objective and unbiased. Shows some analytic creativity.
  
  
2. Develops rudimentary institutional knowledge of primary clients/sponsors; their culture, organization, and issues.
  
  
3. Contributes productively and harmoniously to the work of others; treats everyone respectfully, professionally and fairly. Keeps others informed. Actively engages with colleagues and works with manager to identify opportunities for collaborations within team and division. Seeks out others working on similar topics.
  
  
4. Supports business development efforts and/or marketing activities by conducting background research and helping prepare materials under the direction of more experienced staff.
  
  
5. Limited interaction with sponsors/clients and their study POCs under the supervision of an experienced colleague.
  
  
6. Impact largely confined to individual project work.
  
  
7. Demonstrates basic, effective communication skills, both written and oral. Can effectively present work to colleagues and CNA managers.
  
  
8. Works under close supervision on focused, well-structured pieces of projects.
  
  
9. Exhibits a positive attitude in interactions with colleagues and clients/sponsors. Serves as an effective member of project or research team by supporting leadership as needed.
  
  
10. Performs other duties as assigned.
  
JOB REQUIREMENTS
  
**1. Education:** Minimum master’s degree in science, Technology, Engineering, Math (STEM), aeronautical engineering or equivalent experience
  
  
**2. Experience:** Typical minimum requirements Master’s & 0+ years of experience in research and analysis.
  
  
**3. Skills:** Facility with Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Access, Powerpoint); Ability to manage databases; Ability to gather and organize information on policies, systems, problems, or procedures; Strong critical thinking and organizational skills; Basic knowledge of research techniques; Ability to plan and organize tasks effectively, both as an individual contributor and as a team member; Basic, effective communication skills.
  
  
**4. Remote/Hybrid Work Eligibility:** This position is not eligible for telecommuting or hybrid work arrangements. Occasional flexible work schedule may be possible at the discretion of the Supervisor.
  
  
**5. Relocation:** Relocation assistance is provided
  
  
**6. Other:** An active final Secret security clearance is required at time of hire and the ability to maintain a security clearance.
  
  
CNA offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, which includes health, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, and a 403(b) retirement plan with employer matching. Additionally, we provide generous paid time off programs to promote a health work-life balance. Eligibility for these benefits varies based on employment classification.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:** Established in California in 2013, Green Water and Power has rapidly grown to operate in over 35 states, positioning itself as a leader in the sustainable energy sector. Named the #1 electric vehicle (EV) installer in America, we take pride in having deployed more than 14,000 EV chargers and completed approximately 5 megawatts (MW) of solar energy projects.

As an EVITP (Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Training Program) certified turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firm, we leverage our in-house expertise to efficiently manage and execute large-scale projects. Our dedication to sustainability and quality extends beyond project completion; we also provide comprehensive operation and maintenance services to ensure optimal performance for the projects we develop, as well as for third-party installations.

**Position Overview:** Green Water and Power is seeking an experienced Project Manager to build and lead our new dedicated Greenfield Construction Team. This role owns new-build EV charging infrastructure projects from raw, undeveloped land through energization and handoff to our Operations & Maintenance team, including site civil work, underground utilities, concrete foundations, electrical service, and charger installation. You will direct a traveling team of skilled trades and subcontractors on projects nationwide. This is a high-visibility leadership position for a seasoned construction professional who has delivered ground-up projects and wants the opportunity to shape a team and a playbook from the start.

**Pre-Construction & Planning:**

* Lead due diligence and pre-construction site walks, reviewing geotechnical reports, survey and topographic data, existing utilities, site access, and drainage.
* Review civil, structural, and electrical plan sets and single-line diagrams with engineering; identify constructability issues and value-engineering opportunities before mobilization.
* Develop baseline and look-ahead schedules, budgets, and staffing and equipment plans that sequence excavation, underground, concrete, backfill, and electrical work.
* Coordinate service applications and make-ready work with serving utilities, including transformer pad, service, and metering requirements, and track utility milestones against the schedule.

**Field Execution:**

* Direct day-to-day activities of the Greenfield Team and subcontractors; lead daily safety huddles and weekly progress meetings.
* Ensure 811 utility locates are requested and maintained before any ground disturbance and that critical utilities are verified by potholing.
* Schedule and coordinate AHJ inspections, special inspections, compaction and concrete testing, and utility inspections; maintain inspection logs.
* Partner with the procurement manager on materials and long-lead equipment (switchgear, transformers, chargers) and coordinate deliveries to remote sites.
* Track budget, labor hours, equipment utilization, and change orders; manage RFIs and submittals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for property owners, developers, and client representatives.
* Lead punch lists, final inspections, and commissioning of electrical systems and chargers.
* Deliver as-built drawings, test reports, warranties, and O&M documentation, and hand off completed sites to GWP's O&M team.
* Mentor team members and cross-train them across trades, supporting their growth toward certifications and leadership roles.
* Review and approve time reporting, expense reports, per diem, and travel logistics for the team.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Sr. Construction Manager.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Minimum 4-5 years of construction experience.
* Proven track record managing site civil, underground utility, concrete, and electrical scopes on the same project.
* Experience coordinating with utilities on new services, service upgrades, and low- and medium-voltage electrical infrastructure.
* Ability to read and interpret civil, grading, structural, and electrical drawings, including single-line diagrams.
* Working knowledge of the NEC (including Article 625 for EV charging systems), OSHA construction standards, and local building codes.
* OSHA 30 certification.
* Proficiency with scheduling and project management software (e.g., Salesforce) and Microsoft Office.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage client, utility, and AHJ relationships.
* Capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in different locations.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with EV charging, solar, battery storage, or other energy infrastructure projects.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.

**Travel & Schedule:**

* Travel is required up to 75-100% of the time to greenfield project sites across GWP's operating states.
* Assignments may last several weeks at a time; overnight and extended stays are expected.
* Work may follow a rotational schedule with planned time at home between assignments.
* Company-paid lodging, travel, and daily per diem are provided while on assignment.
* Overtime and weekend work may be necessary to meet project deadlines; flexibility with work hours and extended workdays is required.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary based on experience (DOE), up to $140,000 annually.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits package.
* Retirement savings plan.
* Paid time off.
* Paid training and reimbursement for approved certifications.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding industry.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diversity.
* Opportunity to make a significant impact on the transition to sustainable energy solutions.

**Additional Information:**

* Criminal background check, pre-employment drug screen,

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Whether aloft in the skies aboard a fighter jet protecting the skies or an airborne surveillance platform monitoring developments on the ground, Raytheon’s Agile Radar Solutions (ARS) mission area is responsible for providing advanced capabilities for multiple types of tactical aircraft and other platforms. jobs.description:
**THE POSITION:**
-----------------

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**

Are you a strategic IT project management professional with proven experience leading Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) implementations? Do you excel at managing complex, cross-functional initiatives, coordinating vendors and system integrators, and guiding organizations through major technology transformations? The Inland Empire Utilities Agency (IEUA) is seeking a skilled and motivated Information Technology Project Manager to join our Information Technology team. In this critical role, you will lead and support ERP implementation initiatives and other large-scale technology projects across the full project lifecycle—from planning and requirements gathering through system design, configuration, data migration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live optimization.
  
  
You will collaborate with business units, technical teams, vendors, and executive stakeholders to translate operational requirements into effective ERP solutions, manage system integrations and data migration activities, and help ensure successful implementation and user adoption. You will also oversee project schedules, budgets, risks, deliverables, change management activities, performance metrics, and quality assurance standards. The ideal candidate brings demonstrated experience managing ERP implementations, strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to successfully guide complex enterprise technology projects from planning through deployment. If you’re passionate about ERP transformation, improving business processes, and delivering technology solutions that create lasting organizational value, this opportunity is for you.
  
  
**EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE:**

A typical way of obtaining the knowledge, skills and abilities outlined above is:

Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, project management, or a closely related field, along with a minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in IT program or project management, including at least one (1) year of experience in a leadership role overseeing project and portfolios. A combination of relevant education, certifications, and demonstrated leadership experience may be considered in lieu of experience. Candidates with prior experience directly related to enterprise resource planning are highly desirable.
  
  
**LICENSES; CERTIFICATES; SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:**

A valid California Class C driver's license and the ability to maintain insurability under the Agency's vehicle insurance program.

Possession of the following project management certifications is highly desirable:

Project Management Professional (PMP)

Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)

**Skills and Abilities:**

* Ability to lead and manage ERP implementations and other large-scale technology projects through the full project lifecycle, including planning, requirements gathering, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live optimization.
* Skill in coordinating ERP system integrations, data migration, testing, issue resolution, and implementation readiness across technical and functional teams.
* Ability to manage vendors, consultants, and system integrators, including project deliverables, schedules, budgets, risks, dependencies, and contractual commitments.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively with business units, technical teams, executive leadership, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Skill in analyzing complex business and technical requirements and translating them into effective ERP solutions, project plans, and measurable deliverables.
* Ability to drive organizational change management and successful system adoption through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and user readiness strategies.
* Skill in establishing and monitoring project schedules, budgets, risks, KPIs, quality standards, and executive-level reporting to ensure successful project delivery.
  

To view the full job description, please click here.

**About Us:**

The Inland Empire Utilities Agency is a regional wastewater treatment agency and wholesale distributor of imported water to approximately 950,000 people across 242-square miles in western San Bernardino County. **Global Trade Solutions (GTS)** comprises **4,500+ colleagues across 50+ countries**, supporting suppliers and buyers with export and import finance needs. Trade is where HSBC began in **1865**, when we financed commerce between Europe and Asia.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits covering usually covering healthcare, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. jobs.title: Business Analyst F/H
jobs.description:
**L'entreprise**
----------------

MAGNITUDE est une agence spécialisée en Marketing Opérationnel.

Elle accompagne les plus grandes marques (sport, mode, loisir, tech…) dans leur développement commercial, en mettant l’expérience consommateur au centre des dispositifs en magasin.

Magnitude propose à ses collaborateurs de vivre une aventure humaine aux côtés de professionnels passionnés et enthousiastes.

**Description du poste**
------------------------

Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations Force de Vente au sein du pôle Force de Vente, vous apportez soutien analytique expert et opérationnel, aux Directeurs de Programme en charge de nos projets de force de vente, avec des enjeux forts de développement commercial, d'ouverture de nouveaux comptes et de génération de chiffre d'affaires.

Véritable support auprès des Directeurs de Programme, **vous les appuyez au quotidien dans le pilotage de leur activité** : **vous suivez la performance des équipes terrain** **dont vous** **analysez les résultats**, vous identifiez les tendances et opportunités et vous fournissez, aux Directeurs de Programmes, les analyses nécessaires à la construction de leurs recommandations et plans d’actions.

**Appuyer le Directeur de Programme en pensant les outils de pilotage**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* Comprendre les enjeux du programme, les objectifs fixés et les attentes du client.

* Définir les KPIs pertinents et penser la structure des dashboards.

* Traduire les besoins métiers auprès de l'équipe Data et suivre la construction et l'évolution des outils Power BI.

* Faire évoluer les indicateurs et outils en fonction des besoins du programme et des attentes clients identifiées.

**Suivre et Analyser la performance**
-------------------------------------

* Suivre et analyser les résultats et performances des équipes terrain (par région, commercial, produit, point de vente).

* Identifier les écarts, les tendances, les opportunités et les leviers d'amélioration.

* Réaliser les analyses nécessaires au pilotage de l’activité, auprès du Directeur de programme et faire émerger de l’analyse de la donnée, des recommandations concrètes et quantifiées

**Construire les reportings et les restituer**
----------------------------------------------

* Produire les reportings réguliers (hebdomadaires, mensuels, bilans périodiques) à destination des Managers Régionaux, du Directeur de Programme et du client.

* Mettre en évidence les principaux enseignements et adapter la restitution à chaque interlocuteur.

* Être force de proposition auprès du client pour faire évoluer le contenu et la qualité des reportings.

**Faire vivre les outils et garantir la fiabilité de la donnée**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* S’assurer de la bonne collecte des données nécessaires au pilotage du programme, tout en veillant à la cohérence de l’ensemble de la chaîne data jusqu’à sa restitution

* Assurer le rôle de key user : former les collaborateurs aux outils de suivi et de collecte, être référent(e) sur les procédures et accompagner les utilisateurs en cas d'anomalie.

* Piloter les contrôles de qualité, de cohérence et d'exhaustivité des informations remontées du terrain, et superviser le collaborateur junior en charge de ces contrôles.

* Participer à l'amélioration continue des process et à la veille concurrentielle et marché.

De formation supérieure (école de commerce, marketing ou analyse de données), vous justifiez d'une **expérience consolidée en tant que Business Analyst**, en **analyse de données et pilotage de la performance,** idéalement précédée d'une première expérience commerciale (terrain, développement commercial, gestion de comptes) ou de chef de projet / pilotage de programme.

Vous avez une culture du terrain et **une forte sensibilité business** : vous savez aller au-delà des chiffres, identifier les enseignements clés et les transformer en recommandations d’actions concrètes pour les équipes.

Vous maîtrisez **Excel à un niveau avancé** et avez une bonne maîtrise de **Power BI** pour lire, comprendre et contrôler les rapports et indicateurs existants. Vous savez notamment vérifier la cohérence des résultats, comprendre les règles de calcul et challenger les constructions auprès de l’équipe Data.

Vous comprenez les grands **principes des flux de données**, notamment les fichiers FTP et les API, afin de dialoguer efficacement avec l’équipe Data et de contribuer au suivi des sujets. Une expérience avec des outils d’intelligence artificielle comme Claude est un plus.

Organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et doté(e) d'un bon sens relationnel, vous aimez travailler en transverse avec les équipes terrain et projet tout comme auprès des équipes clients. Curieux(se) et force de proposition, **vous savez rendre des informations complexes simples, lisibles et actionnables**.

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position:**

Intuitive’s Digital organization aims to improve patient care and empower care teams with unique data and insights from our integrated digital ecosystem. Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products and sustaining existing capabilities to our customers and partners.

The role requires a seasoned program delivery leader who combines rigorous project management discipline with the technical fluency needed to manage infrastructure-intensive digital programs in a regulated enterprise environment. This individual will serve as the primary program management accountable party for a portfolio of Digital initiatives spanning software product delivery, cloud infrastructure build-out, platform engineering, and operational readiness—ensuring each program is delivered on scope, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with applicable quality and regulatory standards. **Company Description**  

* **Application Opening:** October 7, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** May close at any time but not before October 21, 2026

**Appointment Type**

This is a Temporary Exempt (TEX), full-time position. This position is excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process, is considered “at will” and shall serve at the discretion of the Appointing Officer. The duration of the appointment shall not exceed 36 months.

**Who We Are**

Through the provision of coordinated, compassionate, and high‐quality services, the Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing strives to make homelessness in San Francisco rare, brief, and one time. The Department provides assistance and support to homeless and at‐risk youth, adults and families to prevent imminent episodes of homelessness and end homelessness for people in San Francisco. Services including outreach, homelessness prevention, emergency shelter, drop‐in centers, transitional housing, supportive housing, short‐term rental subsidies, and support services to help people exit homelessness. For more information on the department, please visit our https://hsh.sfgov.org/.

**What We Do**

San Francisco is a pioneer in homeless services and a leader in providing supportive housing as a permanent exit from homelessness. The Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH), founded in 2016, is a national leader in the movement to end homelessness by developing a coordinated, equity-driven, client-focused system of compassionate services while piloting innovative models, and implementing best practice solutions with measurable results.

HSH’s Homelessness Response System (HRS) oversees and implements a system of care that shelters, houses, and serves approximately 15,000 people daily. Major programs include: street outreach and service connection through the Homeless Outreach Team (SFHOT); 3,600 + bed shelter system for transitional age youth, adults and families including shelters for members of the LGBTQ community; rapid rehousing rental subsidies for families, adults, older adults, and transitional aged youth; the Problem Solving and flexible financial assistance programs; and robust supportive housing programs with over 14, 500 units which provide housing and services to formerly homeless transitional age youth, individuals, and families.

 **Job Description**

The Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH) has an exciting opportunity for an excellent communicator, experienced business analyst, and energetic individual who is passionate about solving homelessness for our community. This highly motivated and team-oriented person will play a key role within the Department’s ONE System Team. Under the general direction of the ONE System Director, the Senior IS Business Analyst will oversee and provide technical leadership for ONE System processes and projects.

The ONE System is an enterprise Software as a Service (SaaS) system and serves as San Francisco’s Homeless Management Information System (HMIS). The ONE System supports HSH and its 75+ community-based organizations to provide a unified system for the City’s Homelessness Response System. The ONE System operationalizes, streamlines, and tracks workflows related to outreach, assessment, prioritization, referral, and placement for families, youth, and individuals seeking housing, shelter and other vital programs and services.

The Senior Business Analyst will support and oversee key aspects of a project to automate the flow of case management data via APIs from individual provider/CBO systems into the ONE System. Currently, providers spend significant time entering duplicative information into their own case management system and the ONE System. By replacing duplicative, manual tasks with an automated data flow, provider case managers can devote more time serving clients. The position will work with various project stakeholders, including HSH program teams, the Department of Technology, community providers, and the ONE System software vendor. The position will generate technical documentation, participate in testing and quality assurance activities, build and maintain dashboards to monitor data and track key metrics, help troubleshoot technical issues, and make process improvement recommendations.

The successful candidate will be a good listener with the ability to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders and the software vendor. They will bridge communication gaps between these groups to meaningfully contribute to the success of the project. If you love finding ways to use technology to help improve the lives of people, this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

**Essential duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Develop technical documentation (e.g., data dictionaries and mapping templates) to support ingesting data from external systems into ONE via an API.
* Analyze ONE System API security permissions to determine required appropriate configuration for secure, connected API integration without granting more access than is needed.
* Support stakeholder communication and engagement by developing slide decks and targeted messaging materials for information sessions. Help facilitate and/or present at stakeholder meetings.
* Contribute to a “Provider API Onboarding Toolkit”, which will serve as a scalable toolkit to streamline the onboarding process for providers to participate in the project.
* Provide data mapping guidance to providers on mapping their source data structures into the required format for successful ingestion into ONE.
* Oversee aspects of testing to validate workflows and system stability for each provider as part of the onboarding process. Support live-data pilot within a secure test environment prior to productio

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Why join us?**  
At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard — from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale

  

**The Role**

The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE-ADS) department is part of GM’s Global Product Safety, System, and Certification (GPSSC) organization. SAFE-ADS serves as a central body for automated driving system (ADS) safety assurance, bringing together technical expertise from across the company to support the safe development, testing, launch, and continuous improvement of advanced driving capabilities.

  

GM is seeking an **Autonomous Vehicle Safety Case Technical Program Manager** to lead the integrated execution of complex, cross-functional safety cases for ADS. This senior/staff individual contributor will bring structure, momentum, and transparency to the workstreams that support GM’s ADS safety case and safety assurance strategy.

The role will coordinate technical and operational work across safety case management, safety and risk management systems, operational safety and human factors, aggregate safety and rules-of-the-road metrics, counterfactual simulation, and related system-safety interfaces. The successful candidate will connect strategy to execution: translating safety objectives into actionable plans, aligning claims and sufficiency criteria with evidence and assessments, managing dependencies and risks, and driving decisions to closure across engineering, validation, operations, legal, public policy, and product teams.

  

This role is ideal for an experienced program leader who is comfortable operating in a technically complex, safety-critical environment; can synthesize diverse inputs into a coherent execution plan; and is motivated by the challenge of enabling the safe, measurable, and scalable deployment of ADS technology.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Integrated Program Leadership

* Build and maintain integrated program plans covering safety case workstreams, milestones, dependencies, resource needs, risks, decisions, and deliverables.

* Establish operating rhythms, governance forums, status reporting, action tracking, decision logs, and escalation paths that enable effective cross-functional execution.

* Align safety case claims with ADS product, engineering, validation, operational, and launch milestones.

* Translate evolving safety strategies and program objectives into clear workstream charters, measurable outcomes, delivery plans, and ownership models.

* Identify schedule, scope, technical, evidence, resource, and cross-functional dependency risks; drive mitigation plans and escalate issues when needed.

* Create clear, concise communications for technical teams, senior leaders, and cross-functional decision forums.

Safety Case and Assurance Execution

* Coordinate the development, assessment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ADS safety cases across product-launch contexts.

* Track evidence readiness, assessment status, substantiation gaps, deviations, and corrective actions; ensure gaps are closed, actively managed, or supported by documented rationale.

* Support impact assessments when the ADS, operational design domain, platform, release, feature behavior, or deployment plan changes.

* Improve the processes, tools, and information flows used to manage the safety case and safety assurance lifecycle.

Continuous Improvement

* Establish scalable methods for planning, prioritization, reporting, evidence management, and change control across SAFE-ADS.

* Use program data and operational feedback to identify systemic issues, improve process health, and increase predictability of safety assurance delivery.

* Promote early and frequent collaboration between safety assurance teams and the engineering and operations organizations developing and deploying ADS capabilities.

Help mature GM’s safety assurance practices as ADS technology, operating scope, evidence methods, and industry expectations evolve.  

  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

* 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in autonomous vehicles, ADAS, software-intensive systems, systems engineering, product safety, safety assurance, or another safety-critical domain.

* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional programs with multiple workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies, and enterprise-level visibility.

* Strong program management capabilities, including integrated planning, milestone management, dependency tracking, risk management, governance, issue resolution, and executive communication.

* Experience translating ambiguous technical or safety objectives into structured execution plans, measurable outcomes, and clear ownership.

**Company Description**

**Appointment Type:** This is a Temporary Provisional (TPV) position excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process. It is considered "at will" and shall serve at the discretion of the Department Head. This position will be subject to the Permanent Civil Service examination process at a later date. Successful participation in the Permanent Civil Service examination and selection through an open competitive process is needed in order to be considered for the permanent appointment.

Application Opening: October 7, 2026

Application Deadline: May close anytime but not before October 22, 2026, at 11:59 PM (PST)

Compensation Range: $129,636 - $157,612 annually

Recruitment ID: RTF0168079-01156693

**Who We Are**

Through the provision of coordinated, compassionate, and high‐quality services, the Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH) strives to make homelessness in San Francisco rare, brief, and one time. The Department provides assistance and support to homeless and at‐risk youth, adults, and families to prevent imminent episodes of homelessness and end homelessness for people in San Francisco. Services including outreach, homelessness prevention, emergency shelter, drop‐in centers, transitional housing, supportive housing, short‐term rental subsidies, and support services to help people exit homelessness. For more information about the department, please visit our website at https://hsh.sfgov.org.

**What We Do**

San Francisco is a pioneer in homeless services and a leader in providing supportive housing as a permanent exit from homelessness. The Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH), founded in 2016, is a national leader in the movement to end homelessness by developing a coordinated, equity-driven, client-focused system of compassionate services while piloting innovative models, and implementing best practice solutions with measurable results.

HSH’s Homelessness Response System (HRS) funds, oversees and implements a system of care that shelters, houses, and serves approximately 15,000 people daily. Major programs include: street outreach and service connection through the Homeless Outreach Team (SFHOT); 3,600+ bed shelter system for transitional age youth, adults and families including shelters for members of the LGBTQ community; Rapid Rehousing rental subsidies for families, adults, older adults, and transitional aged youth; the Problem Solving and flexible financial assistance programs; and robust supportive housing programs with over 14,500 units which provide housing and services to formerly homeless transitional age youth, individuals, and families.

 **Job Description**

**What You’ll Be Doing**

The Rapid Rehousing Program Manager supports the planning, implementation, oversight, and continuous improvement of Rapid Rehousing programs funded by HSH. Rapid Rehousing provides time-limited rental assistance and supportive services to help people experiencing homelessness obtain housing in the private rental market and transition toward long-term housing stability, including nonprofit provider agreements, program budgets, utilization, housing placements, participant outcomes, and program performance.

HSH has a longstanding portfolio of Rapid Rehousing programs, and the City continues to invest in and expand these programs as part of its Breaking the Cycle strategy. The Program Manager will play a central role in implementing this investment and the next phase of HSH's RRH portfolio, including implementation of newly procured programs and provider agreements, provider and program transitions, and efforts to strengthen and standardize program operations. The position will help ensure that new and existing investments translate into timely referrals and housing placements, strong program utilization, effective provider performance, and successful participant outcomes.

The Program Manager works across HSH and with nonprofit providers, Coordinated Entry, housing partners, other City departments, and governmental and community partners to translate HSH's housing strategies into effective program operations. The position uses program, fiscal, and performance data to identify challenges, develop solutions, and recommend changes to program design, policy, funding, and operations. The Rapid Rehousing Program Manager reports to the Scattered Site Housing Programs Supervisor and is part of HSH's Housing Division.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manages assigned Rapid Rehousing (RRH) programs and provider grant agreements.
* Implements new and reprocured RRH programs, provider transitions, and other program changes.
* Develops and manages scopes of work, program deliverables, outcome objectives, and grant modifications.
* Monitors program budgets and expenditures and supports budget development, projections, revisions, and modifications.
* Monitors referrals, enrollment, utilization, housing placements, exits, and housing retention outcomes.
* Works with providers to identify and address program performance concerns and improve outcomes.
* Ensures providers deliver housing stabilization and retention services to support participants following housing placement and through successful program exit.
* Analyzes program, fiscal, and ONE System/HMIS data to identify trends, barriers, and opportunities for program improvement.
* Monitors provider data quality and works with providers and HSH staff to resolve reporting issues.
* Develops and updates RRH policies, procedures, program standards, and operational guidance in coordination with HSH leadership.
* Conducts annual program monitoring and follows up on findings and corrective actions.
* Coordinates with Coordinated Entry and providers to support timely referrals and maximize program utilization.
* Identifies and works to resolve barriers to housing search, lease-up, stabilization, and successful program exits.

Responsibilities include developing and integrating stress testing processes, overseeing documentation, guiding scenario design, and preparing reports for senior management and regulators. Lexia's data is central to how we grow and how we demonstrate impact. We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to turn that data into timely, actionable reporting and analysis that shape outcomes across our go-to-market teams.

Reporting to the Director of Data Strategy & Analytics, the Senior Business Intelligence Analyst will be a hands-on analytics partner to Customer Success, Marketing, and Sales. Working with the data models built by our Analytics Engineering team, you will develop the dashboards, KPIs, analyses and AI agents that help these teams understand performance, spot opportunities, and act on them.

This role sits at the intersection of the business and our data. You will translate stakeholder questions into clear analytical approaches, communicate what the data shows and what to do about it, and help build the self-service and AI-enabled tools that let more of Lexia get answers directly.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Reporting & Dashboard Development**
  + Build, maintain, and continuously improve Tableau dashboards and reports that give Customer Success, Marketing, and Sales executives clear visibility into pipeline, bookings, renewals, product usage, campaign performance, and other key business metrics.
  + Develop and maintain meaningful, well-defined KPIs, ensuring metrics are consistent across reports and aligned with agreed-upon business definitions.
  + Deliver recurring business performance reporting and forecasting that executives can rely on for planning and operational conclusions.

* **Business Analysis & Insights**
  + Conduct in-depth analyses of revenue, customer, and operational data to answer key business questions, such as campaign attribution, account scoring, pipeline health, and retention/churn drivers.
  + Go beyond reporting what happened to explain why, and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations through strong data storytelling.
  + Handle ad hoc and confidential analysis requests with accuracy, sound judgment, and appropriate care for sensitive data.

* **Data Models & Collaboration with Analytics Engineering**
  + Use the data warehouse marts and Tableau Cloud data sources provided by Analytics Engineering as the foundation for reporting and analysis, writing SQL to explore, validate, and combine data as needed.
  + Translate stakeholder needs into clear data requirements and metric definitions, and partner with Analytics Engineering to request new or enhanced data models when gaps arise.
  + Identify and escalate data quality issues, and help establish consistent data and reporting standards that increase confidence in our numbers.

* **Stakeholder Partnership**

  + Scope requests with stakeholders, set clear expectations on timelines, and help prioritize work in partnership with the Director of Data Strategy & Analytics.

* **Self-Service & AI-Enabled Analytics**
  + Contribute to the design and rollout of self-service dashboards, AI agents, and conversational analytics tools that enable non-technical staff to answer questions of our data directly.
  + Support stakeholder enablement through documentation, training, and office hours, and follow data and AI governance policies to ensure analytics tools and data are used appropriately.
  + Look for opportunities to automate recurring work and apply new tools and best practices that improve scale, efficiency, and quality.

**Job Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, data science, analytics, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in an analytical role, with a preference for experience supporting sales, marketing, customer success, or business operations.
* Advanced proficiency in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool) and exceptional SQL skills for querying and validating data in a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Redshift).
* Experience working with curated data models built by data or analytics engineering teams; familiarity with Dbt is a plus.
* Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM, and with Excel.
* Demonstrated experience producing business-driven dashboards and reports and developing meaningful KPIs.
* Experience with go-to-market analyses such as campaign attribution, account scoring, pipeline analysis, or retention/churn analysis; familiarity with Python or R for statistical analysis is a plus.
* Interest in or experience with AI-assisted analytics tools, such as AI agents, natural language query interfaces, or LLM-driven analytics.
* Experience within a SaaS B2B or B2G organization preferred.
* Curiosity and a passion for asking “why?” to get to the root of an issue, paired with effective deductive and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Excellent attention to detail, excellent follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, changing environment.

To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit https://www.lexialearning.com/.

Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. Join Lockheed Martin’s digital transformation journey as we accelerate the OneLM Mission-Driven Transformation through our 1LMX program. **About Us**

At Alteva RCM, we're dedicated to helping healthcare providers thrive through expert revenue cycle management, strategic insight, and innovative solutions. We're always looking for passionate, driven professionals who want to make a meaningful impact, grow their careers, and be part of a collaborative team committed to excellence.

Alteva RCM is seeking a highly organized Project Manager to support a complex operations and technology environment spanning multiple internal systems, process improvement initiatives, reporting workflows, and vendor-supported delivery.

This role will serve as a central point of coordination across operational and technology projects, owning project planning, status tracking, stakeholder communication, risk and blocker follow-up, documentation hygiene, and delivery visibility across cross-functional teams. The Project Manager will support the requirements process by capturing discussion points, tracking open questions, coordinating stakeholder input, and ensuring decisions and next steps are clearly documented.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across business and technical teams. They can turn discussions into clear next steps, timelines, owners, follow-ups, and measurable progress.

* Drive project follow-through from intake through requirements, development, QA, release readiness, and post-release tracking.
* Translate business discussions into clear requirements, action items, owners, timelines, and open questions.

* Comfortable managing ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving environments.
* Strong follow-up discipline and ownership mindset.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with Jira and Notion specifically.
* Experience working with Salesforce-related projects.
* Background in healthcare operations, revenue operations, regulated operations, or complex workflow-driven environments.
* Experience coordinating with external development vendors or offshore teams.
* Familiarity with QA, UAT, release management, and production support processes.
* Comfort in environments where processes are still being built.

**Location & Availability**
---------------------------

This is a fully remote role. It requires a minimum of 6 hours daily overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours, with availability for periodic coordination with Israel-based stakeholders as needed.

Eastern Europe time zones may work well for this role, though other locations will be considered if the overlap requirement is met.

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Marketing is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead builder enablement programs within Marketing Strategy, Operations & Enablement (MSOE). In this role, you will serve as the strategic lead for cross-functional programs that develop and empower AWS Marketing builders — including early career talent, people managers, and the broader marketing population — to grow, deliver results, and enable their teams.  
  
You will develop and execute program strategy as the single-threaded owner of three flagship programs: the Early Career Talent (ECT) program, Inside AWS Marketing Spotlight Series (IAMSS), and AWS Marketing Manager Central. These programs share knowledge globally and create experiences that raise the bar for builders at every level.  
  
The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader who thrives in ambiguity, earns trust across organizational boundaries, and leverages qualitative and quantitative data to continuously evolve programs. You think big about strategy, dive deep into execution, and communicate with clarity and confidence to senior leaders.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
Early Career Talent (ECT) Program (~60%)  
Lead the ECT program end-to-end — developing and executing the experience strategy for interns and their managers from post-offer acceptance through offboarding.  
Drive manager enablement across the full lifecycle: preparation, onboarding, intern project planning, performance management resources, and serving as the central point of contact to unblock success.  
Design and deliver intern programming — including pre-Day One communications, org-specific onboarding, skill-building sessions, Ask Me Anythings, and lunch-and-learns — that provides an expansive, diversified experience.  
Inspect program quality through surveys, focus groups, and 1:1 mechanisms; identify and act on improvement opportunities.  
Own year-round program strategy, including postmortems, operating plans, and experience strategy documents that codify execution and think big about amplifying impact.  
Build and execute a brand strategy for the ECT program to improve awareness and engagement across AWS Marketing, including among the Marketing Leadership Team (MLT).  
Lead the ECT Tiger Team with cross-functional partners (AUTA, PXT, Finance, Talent Acquisition, WFP) — owning agendas, tracking milestones, and driving accountability.  
  
Inside AWS Marketing Spotlight Series (~20%)  
Own the IAMSS program strategy and vision, including the content calendar, themes, and tenets grounding each session.  
Partner with the CMO's Communications team to prioritize topics; identify and recruit speakers, serving as the final decision maker on content and program direction.  
Develop promotion mechanisms to drive attendance and prime the funnel for future sessions.  
Inspect attendee feedback and evolve the series format and strategy accordingly.  
  
AWS Marketing Manager Central (~20%)  
Own the Manager Central Quick app, including quarterly content refreshes to keep action items and timelines current.  
Maintain a 2–3 day SLA on responding to manager feedback submitted through the app.  
Partner with PXT bimonthly to review feedback, make go/no-go decisions, and incorporate approved inputs into the manager enablement strategy roadmap.  
Inspect performance via feedback trends and app analytics (unique visitors, engagement patterns) to identify improvement opportunities.

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

new_jobs.description:
**The Team:**

At Datadog, People Operations is more than just human resources—it's a data-driven team dedicated to constantly improving the way we hire, develop, and support our most valuable asset: our people. Our People team are strategic problem solvers who work closely with leadership and employees to ensure that Datadog keeps scaling smoothly and remains a great place to work.

  

**The Opportunity:**

As a Compensation Program Manager, you will combine compensation expertise, program management, analytics, systems thinking, and stakeholder management to help build and scale our compensation programs. You will own critical compensation processes from strategy and design through execution, communications, enablement, and continuous improvement.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both strategic problem solving and hands-on program execution, can translate complex compensation concepts into simple experiences for managers and employees, and thrives in a highly cross-functional environment.

*At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.*

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Develop and execute scalable compensation programs and processes, including compensation and equity cycles, governance, timelines, and tools, in partnership with People, Finance, HRIS, Payroll, Legal, and business leaders
* Build dynamic compensation models and scenario analyses to support budgeting, workforce planning, and compensation design for cash/equity
* Provide operational analysis, reporting, and insights related to compensation programs, trends, market data, and internal equity
* Oversee compensation functionality and data in our systems and partner with HRIS and Analytics to continually enhance compensation and total rewards tooling
* Lead communications and change management for compensation programs and processes, including FAQs, manager resources, training, and enablement
* Partner cross-functionally to drive complex compensation initiatives from design through implementation and continuously improve processes and employee experience

**Who You Are:**

* Five to seven years or more, of compensation or related experience
* A flexible, low-ego approach to building and scaling the function, comfortable operating across high-level strategic program design and hands-on analytics, reporting, data cleanup, and operational execution
* Experience managing compensation programs and annual cycles, including equity programs and/or other variable compensation
* Strong analytical rigor and experience building dynamic models and scenario analyses
* Experience implementing and using compensation benchmarking data, market pricing methodologies, reporting, and compensation technology
* A good understanding of RSUs and other equity offerings
* Strong business acumen and the ability to translate complex compensation concepts into digestible information for leaders and employees
* A "systems" thinker oriented towards process improvement, scalability, and efficiency
* Advanced capabilities in Excel
* Strong knowledge of Workday functionality and reporting
* Exceptional cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience developing communications, training, and change-management materials

*Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.*

  

**Benefits & Growth:**

* Generous and competitive global and US benefits
* New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
* Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
* Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
* Best in breed onboarding
* Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally
* Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

*Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.*

#LI-Hybrid

**About Datadog:**

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. new_jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**New York State Homes and Community Renewal (HCR)** is the State’s affordable housing agency, with a mission to build, preserve, and protect affordable housing and increase homeownership throughout New York State.

*This position is with HCR’s* ***Affordable Housing Corporation (AHC)****. This is not a civil service position, and a civil service exam is not required. Candidates must meet the minimum qualifications outlined below to be considered.*

NYS Homes and Community Renewal (HCR) is committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility. Our work would not be possible without the diverse backgrounds, experiences, ideas, and abilities of our employees. HCR is committed to developing a workforce that represents the diverse population of New York State. HCR embraces a diverse and inclusive work environment by encouraging all individuals, including those with disabilities, to apply to open positions at the agency.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  
Business Analysis & Process Improvement

* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business needs, gather requirements, and identify opportunities for business operations and data improvement
* Develop business cases, current (“as-is”) and future (“to-be”) processes, and recommend strategic solutions to improve operations, policy, and performance
* Translate business needs into technical requirements and ensure alignment across teams to support project execution, requirements documentation, test planning, issue tracking, and risk reporting
* Troubleshoot system or process issues and coordinate with cross-functional teams to implement and test fixes
* Apply process improvement methods to optimize workflows, eliminate inefficiencies, and improve service delivery through structured change management
* Use critical thinking and data-driven decision making to resolve business and technical challenges efficiently

Project Management

* Lead end-to-end delivery of strategic projects, define scope, project plans, timelines, budgets, risks, and success metrics
* Facilitate effective meetings with clear communication and alignment across leadership and teams
* Support change management efforts

Data Management

* Partner with program teams to understand program data, define data requirements and standards, and create documentation (e.g., schemas, dictionaries)
* Contribute to agency-wide data governance and ensure compliance with internal controls and quality standards
* Use analytics to inform decision-making and align data initiatives with broader business and technology strategies

Leadership & Mentorship

* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on complex, cross-functional projects
* Mentor junior staff, sharing tools, techniques, and best practices across business analysis, project management, and SDLC
* Lead collaborative, inclusive teams and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement
* Adapt leadership style based on expertise of team

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant area e.g., Information Technology, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or related field
* 8-10 years of experience working on large scale projects in a lead position
* Working knowledge of database concepts and design preferred

This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will be expected to perform other reasonably related duties as assigned.

**WHAT WE OFFER AT NYS HCR:**

* Extensive benefits package including paid leave, including excellent health, dental, vision and retirement benefits with the New York State & Local Employees’ Retirement System.
* Promotional opportunity for dedicated professionals.
* Work life balance benefits include a 37.5-hour work week and paid time off benefits including vacation, sick, personal days, and Federal Holidays.
* Opportunity for compressed scheduling.
* 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave.
* Paid Family Leave.
* Opportunity for compressed/flextime scheduling.
* As a New York State employee, you may qualify to participate in the Federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSLF). The PSLF Program forgives the remaining balance on your Direct Loans after you have made 120 qualifying monthly payments under an accepted repayment plan and while working full-time for an eligible employer.

***Additional SONYMA/HFA/AHC Benefits:***

* Cash in for Wellness! This program provides you with the option of buying or renewing a health club membership of your choice or enrolling in a weight loss and or smoking cessation program, using your sick leave accruals.
* Tuition reimbursement program – for job related and non-job-related courses.
* Vacation Leave Buy-Back program – Subject to approval, every year eligible employees may exchange previously earned and accrued vacation time in return for cash compensation (at employee’s daily rate of pay at time of exchange).
* Access to Plum Benefits – savings on movie tickets, theme parks, hotels, tours, Broadway shows and more!
Optical reimbursement program – Employees are eligible for optical, hearing aid, and podiatric expenses not otherwise covered by insurance, with a maximum aggregate amount of $650 per year, per family. Unused yearly balances may be carried over to next year for a maximum of $1,300.  

**ABOUT NEW YORK STATE HOMES AND COMMUNITY RENEWAL:**  
Under the leadership of Governor Kathy Hochul and Commissioner RuthAnne Visnauskas, ***HCR*** is a vibrant, innovative agency that integrates and leverages New York State’s housing resources. We have offices in New York City, Albany, Buffalo, and Syracuse, and employ a diverse workforce of professionals who are hard-working and committed to serving low- and moderate-income families. Our mission is far reaching, encompassing single and multifamily housing finance, home improvement, rent regulation, housing subsidies, and community development. We partner regularly with a variety of public and private stakeholders.

* 560048

* New York

* Environment Health/Safety Off

* Full Time

* Opening on: Oct 7 2026

* Grade 10

* Job Type: Officer of Administration
* Bargaining Unit:
