*The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to departmental budgets, qualifications, experience, education, licenses, specialty, and training. The above hiring range represents the University's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.*

  

Position Summary

Reporting to the Manager of Data Programs, the Data Analyst will monitor and support Environmental Health & Safety’s (EH&S) internal and external technology applications, ensuring that the highest level of service is provided to the Columbia University research community. The preferred candidate must have a passion for data integrity, analytics, accuracy, efficiency and be part of a team that provides expert guidance and timely service to the University research community.

  

The Data Analyst will process tasks with high efficiency and quality, in a fast-paced environment to support technology solutions that address the operational needs and requirements of EH&S and the University’s research community. The preferred candidate will excel at working in a team environment, supporting and troubleshooting technology applications, communicating findings and processes effectively, and will develop relationships with staff, clients and vendors to ensure effective/efficient implementation of existing and planned technology-based environmental health and safety programs.

**Subject to business needs, we may support flexible and hybrid work arrangements. Options will be discussed during the interview process.**

Responsibilities

* Collaborate with the Data Analyst II and EH&S management team in the development and application of tools and resources to further the goals of Columbia University's EH&S programs.
* Gather requirements, assess operational challenges, and work with EH&S stakeholders and the research community to identify technology-based solutions.
* Support the relationships between EH&S and Software as a Service (SaaS) vendors and liaise with University IT resources.
* Contribute to the implementation, ongoing use and refinement of environmental health and safety software applications, tools and information systems.
* Visit research laboratories in the field to support EH&S database verification, reconcile data, deliver laboratory supplies as needed, and communicate with researchers to collect, validate, and improve data points.
* Assist in the administration of the chemical tracking program, including community outreach and education, monitoring the completion of relevant tasks, and assessing workflow efficiencies.
* Troubleshoot application issues by identifying the source of the problem, resolving issues directly when appropriate, or coordinating with outside vendors for resolution.
* Respond in a timely manner to issues and requests such as account creation, value updates and status reports within EH&S software applications, tools and information system issues.
* Assist with updating EH&S online materials including informational documents and website.
* Assist with the design, creation & delivery of EH&S training for software system platforms and functions.
* Create surveys for data collection with meaningful and actionable questions.
* Generate and analyze reports using large datasets, including user, location, asset, inspection, and chemical data, to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement in a fast-paced environment.
* Present reports to stakeholders, communicate key insights, answer questions, and translate findings into practical recommendations and technology improvements that support departmental and research operations.
* Follow established data integrity workflows and create new procedures by developing question sets related to contact info, work locations and lab members to ensure completeness, accuracy and timely follow-through.
* Participate in the evaluation of new technologies to ensure that data analysis and visualization tools are in line with EH&S needs.
* Assist in the evaluation, development and implementation of artificial intelligence tools to automate administrative tasks and create opportunities for efficiency.
* Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required with an educational emphasis in Computer Science, Information Systems, Life Sciences, Engineering or related field; 1+ year(s) of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with administrating database systems is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Power Query and VBA is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with Power BI.
* Familiarity with generative AI tools.
* Experience with AI-assisted coding tools.
* Experience with automation workflow software.
* Familiarity with updating websites built using a content management system (CMS) is preferred.
* Familiarity with working in a research, laboratory, or academic setting.

Other Requirements

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong organizational, interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to train others on the effective use of technology applications.
* Demonstrated professionalism, creativity, and sound judgment while working in a team-based, collaborative environment.
* Willingness to develop a practical understanding of environmental health and safety issues and actively support EH&S operations.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst, Private Markets
new_jobs.description:
**COMPANY: Canoe Intelligence**

**WEBSITE:** **https://canoeintelligence.com/**

**TITLE:** Data Analyst, Private Markets

**LOCATION:** New York City (hybrid)

**SALARY:** $70,000 - $100,000 + Bonus

**The Role:**

You are an emerging operations professional eager to grow your career at the intersection of private markets and cutting-edge AI. As a member of our Canoe Data Operations Team, you will apply your expertise in private market data to build, define, and execute on our product and service offering—while supporting day-to-day operations, ensuring data quality, and tackling the operational complexity of the private markets ecosystem.

You will work alongside senior team members to manage delivery through our onshore and offshore teams, contribute to the accuracy and efficiency of our platform, and partner closely with Product Managers to help shape the future product roadmap. This is an exciting opportunity to own core functionality and drive meaningful improvements across service delivery and ongoing operations.

**What You'll Do:**

**Operational Support & Workflow Management:**

* Support Document Processing Workflows: Assist in the intake, review, and processing of LP documents (Capital Account Statements, PCAPs, Call/Distribution Notices), ensuring they move through the pipeline accurately and on time.
* Monitor & Triage Exceptions: Review automated outputs, identify processing exceptions or anomalies, and escalate or resolve issues in coordination with senior operations staff.
* Deliver Quality: Reconcile extraction data against source documents, manage conflicting data points, and maintain high standards across all client deliverables.

**Subject Matter Expertise & Data Quality:**

* Be an SME: Become a go-to individual within Canoe for private market data points—including underlying asset data such as cost basis, valuations, and operating metrics—and support the manipulation and enrichment of such data.
* Advocate for Standards: Champion best practices, perform quality checks, and drive consistency across the team to foster a culture of excellence.
* Derive Insights: Perform analysis on data trends to inform our product and service offering, and flag patterns that can inform process improvements or automation opportunities.

**Process Improvement & Product Development:**

* Continuous Improvement: Identify technology and process improvements to efficiently and effectively process data, and assist in refining operating procedures.
* Document Operational Logic: Help capture and organize process notes, workflow rules, and exception-handling procedures to be shared across operations and product teams.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with Data, Product, and Engineering teams to communicate operational needs, contribute to product roadmap discussions, and flag issues that require systemic fixes.

**Collaboration & Client Support:**

* Manage Offshore Coordination: Support delivery through onshore and offshore team structures, ensuring work is executed accurately and on schedule.
* Client-Adjacent Support: Assist client-facing team members by preparing operational summaries and data quality reports that support client communications and onboarding.

**What We're Looking For:**

You will be a trusted partner to delivery teams when a process is not working as it should, and to leadership when they need a clear view of how the portfolio is performing.

* Represent ITSM practices in the SMO’s governance cadence and communicate practice health to stakeholders and leadership.

* Functional competencies include attention to detail, communication, customer focus, prioritization, and drive.

Safety

* Leads by example show that safety is the most important function, ensuring that all employees follow safe practices while working.

* Strong knowledge of electrical power systems, inverters, transformer

**Main Purpose of Job**
-----------------------

This position serves as the Program Manager for the Office of Overdose Prevention and Education within the Division of Prevention and Promotion at the Behavioral Health Administration (BHA). As a senior-level manager, this position leads Maryland’s statewide drug user health program infrastructure and oversees the development, implementation, and oversight of programs aimed at reducing substance use-related morbidity and mortality, particularly among people who use drugs.  
  

The Program Manager is responsible for administering Drug User Health Services, which include initiatives such as overdose education and naloxone distribution (OEND), Opioid Associated Disease Prevention and Outreach Programs (OADPOP)s, drug user health training and capacity building, epidemiological surveillance, and systems-level coordination. Additionally, this position oversees efforts to expand access to buprenorphine in community-based settings through the Medication for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD) Intervention Unit, which includes the Hub and Spoke model, Overdose Survivors Outreach Programs, Screening, Brief Intervention, and Referral to Treatment (SBIRT), and Maryland Addiction Consultation Services (MACS).

  
  

With a combined budget of approximately $30 million, this position provides strategic and programmatic leadership to ensure drug user health programs are effectively managed, fiscally accountable, and compliant with federal and state guidelines. The Program Manager also represents BHA in multi-agency collaborations, advises senior leadership on policy and funding priorities, and ensures alignment with BHA’s mission to support equity, recovery, and health for all Marylanders impacted by substance use.

  
  

This position is eligible for hybrid telework, which is subject to change as necessitated by operations and customer-focused demands.

Qualified candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and six years of health or human services administrative or professional experience, including three years at a supervisory or managerial level.

* Experience supervising managers and multidisciplinary teams, including programmatic, epidemiological, technical, and administrative staff.

* Experience developing policy, operational protocols, and strategic recommendations related to substance use, overdose prevention, or public health.

* Experience using epidemiological and programmatic data to inform program implementation, evaluation, resource allocation, and quality improvement.

* Experience collaborating with state agencies, local jurisdictions, community-based organizations, healthcare partners, and other stakeholders on complex statewide initiatives.

This is a Management Service position and serves at the pleasure of the Appointing Authority. A resume must be uploaded to your application.

Serco is excited to continue our support for the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.

The F-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting-edge technologies to the battle-space of the future. The F-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems & Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Marketing is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead builder enablement programs within Marketing Strategy, Operations & Enablement (MSOE). In this role, you will serve as the strategic lead for cross-functional programs that develop and empower AWS Marketing builders — including early career talent, people managers, and the broader marketing population — to grow, deliver results, and enable their teams.  
  
You will develop and execute program strategy as the single-threaded owner of three flagship programs: the Early Career Talent (ECT) program, Inside AWS Marketing Spotlight Series (IAMSS), and AWS Marketing Manager Central. These programs share knowledge globally and create experiences that raise the bar for builders at every level.  
  
The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader who thrives in ambiguity, earns trust across organizational boundaries, and leverages qualitative and quantitative data to continuously evolve programs. You think big about strategy, dive deep into execution, and communicate with clarity and confidence to senior leaders.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
Early Career Talent (ECT) Program (~60%)  
Lead the ECT program end-to-end — developing and executing the experience strategy for interns and their managers from post-offer acceptance through offboarding.  
Drive manager enablement across the full lifecycle: preparation, onboarding, intern project planning, performance management resources, and serving as the central point of contact to unblock success.  
Design and deliver intern programming — including pre-Day One communications, org-specific onboarding, skill-building sessions, Ask Me Anythings, and lunch-and-learns — that provides an expansive, diversified experience.  
Inspect program quality through surveys, focus groups, and 1:1 mechanisms; identify and act on improvement opportunities.  
Own year-round program strategy, including postmortems, operating plans, and experience strategy documents that codify execution and think big about amplifying impact.  
Build and execute a brand strategy for the ECT program to improve awareness and engagement across AWS Marketing, including among the Marketing Leadership Team (MLT).  
Lead the ECT Tiger Team with cross-functional partners (AUTA, PXT, Finance, Talent Acquisition, WFP) — owning agendas, tracking milestones, and driving accountability.  
  
Inside AWS Marketing Spotlight Series (~20%)  
Own the IAMSS program strategy and vision, including the content calendar, themes, and tenets grounding each session.  
Partner with the CMO's Communications team to prioritize topics; identify and recruit speakers, serving as the final decision maker on content and program direction.  
Develop promotion mechanisms to drive attendance and prime the funnel for future sessions.  
Inspect attendee feedback and evolve the series format and strategy accordingly.  
  
AWS Marketing Manager Central (~20%)  
Own the Manager Central Quick app, including quarterly content refreshes to keep action items and timelines current.  
Maintain a 2–3 day SLA on responding to manager feedback submitted through the app.  
Partner with PXT bimonthly to review feedback, make go/no-go decisions, and incorporate approved inputs into the manager enablement strategy roadmap.

* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

new_jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of an all-source analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing the intelligence community is no longer how to get more data, it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data, and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security.

  

As a Defense Critical Infrastructure All-Source Analyst on our team, you’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client understand their mission environment. You'll work with interagency teams to determine threats to DoD critical infrastructure, providing executive clients with threat briefings and mitigation opportunities. This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills, and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our policymakers.

  

Join us. The world can’t wait.

  

**You Have:**

* Experience in identifying threats to U.S. interests and executing directed tasks supporting the Defense Critical Infrastructure Program, Defense Foreign Material Program, DoD Analytic Agenda, Defense Acquisition System, and Technology Security Program
* Experience with strategic all-source intelligence analysis, including using analytic tools to research data from multiple intelligence sources and analyzing findings
* Experience with authoring current DoD product lines and utilizing ICD 203 tradecraft standards
* Ability to develop high-quality deliverables tailored to senior policymakers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings
* Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
* Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience with analysis or 12+ years of experience with analysis in lieu of a degree

* Experience with data analytics, analysis, and visualization
* Knowledge of the intelligence cycle
* Knowledge of one of the following AORs: the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, or Eurasia

new_jobs.title: Security Analyst - Technical Security - Entry to Experienced Level (Maryland)
new_jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

Security and Counterintelligence is responsible for the protection of NSA/CSS information, people, and facilities worldwide. In support of this mission, Security personnel oversee the development, installation, and maintenance of physical security systems. Security personnel help maintain integral elements of an overall security theory, posture, and infrastructure designed to efficiently deter, delay, detect and identify threats to NSA people, resources and facilities.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Federal employees - Excepted service**

Current federal employees whose agencies have their own hiring rules, pay scales and evaluation criteria.

### **Veterans**

Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces or a spouse, widow, widower or parent of a veteran, who may be eligible for derived preference

### **Military spouses**

Military spouses of active duty service members or whose spouse is 100 percent disabled or died on active duty.

  

**Duties**
----------

Security and Counterintelligence is responsible for the protection of NSA/CSS information, people and facilities worldwide. In support of this mission, Technical Security Analysts provide security analysis, risk recommendations, and mitigations to decision makers and customers. They develop and monitor the implementation and effectiveness of countermeasures for mitigating security risks. Technical Security Analysts prepare and maintain assessments and security databases detailing the findings, recommendations, status, and results of assessment actions.
  
  
Technical Security Analyst responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Applying principles, methods, and tools for assessing and mitigating threats/vulnerabilities
* Understanding commercial information technology marketplace, products, and services
* Assessing applicability of available tools to various situations
* Understanding the principal methods and techniques of gathering intelligence information
* Evaluating the scope and availability of intelligence analysis tools available at NSA
* Preparing and maintaining files, risk assessments, and technical security databases detailing the findings, recommendations, status, and results of assessment actions.
* Developing and monitoring implementation and effectiveness of countermeasures for mitigating security risks.
* Briefing customers and managers concerning technical security policy and procedures and specific cases.
* Applying technical security policy and regulations
* Using resources effectively and efficiently to arrange information in a useful manner
* Obtaining, evaluating, organizing, and maintaining information
* Disseminating information to appropriate internal and external parties
* Creating a product based on analysis of security and/or counterintelligence data
* Providing timely and accurate responses to requests for assistance, information, products or services
* Authoring routine and/or detailed documents such as assessments, reports, and memorandums
* Completing coursework and certifications through the US Air Force TEMPEST School and/or the Interagency Training Center.

  
The agency is currently hiring Security Analysts to specialize in:
  

* Technical Security

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* All applicants and employees are subject to random drug testing in accordance with Executive Order 12564.

### **Qualifications**

The qualifications listed are the minimum acceptable to be considered for the position.
  
  
Relevant experience must be in one or more of the following: signals analysis, intelligence analysis, financial analysis, research analysis, physical or personnel security, TEMPEST, radio frequency, counterintelligence, electrical/electronics, technical surveillance countermeasures, telecommunications, wireless security, network packet analysis, cybersecurity, acquisition management, risk assessment, or security and counterintelligence (CI) investigations, or construction/facilities.
  
  
ENTRY/DEVELOPMENTAL
  
Entry is with a high school diploma or GED plus 4 years of relevant experience, or an Associate's degree plus 2 years of relevant experience, or relevant military experience and 2 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's degree and no experience.
  
  
FULL PERFORMANCE
  
Entry is with a high school diploma or GED plus 7 years of relevant experience, or an Associate's degree plus 5 years of relevant experience, or relevant military experience and 2 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's degree plus 3 years of relevant experience, or relevant security training plus 3 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree plus 1 year of relevant experience, or a Doctoral degree and no experience.

### **Education**

A degree in any field is acceptable. Military training must be at least 18 semester hours of training in security analysis.

### **Additional information**

Pay: Salary offers are based on candidates' education level and years of experience relevant to the position and also take into account information provided by the hiring manager/organization regarding the work level for the position.
  
  
Salary Range: $57,736 - $133,142 (Entry, Full Performance)
  
Salary range varies by location, work level, and relevant experience to the position.
  
  
Training will be provided based on the selectee's needs and experience.
  
  
Benefits: NSA offers a comprehensive benefits package.
  
  
Work Schedule: This is a full-time position, Monday - Friday, with basic 8hr/day work requirement between 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. (flexible).

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

Benefits

* Evaluating existing methodologies and developing recommendations for improved processes, tools, analytics, and infrastructure
* Identifying and leveraging capabilities from across MITRE that enable the sponsor to measurably increase mission impact

* Understanding of computer networks and the OSI model, spanning hardware, software, and networking components, including how data flows and is secured across all layers.
* Experience with C5ISR-T analysis.

Onsite

**Overview**

The Cyber Defense Investigations team is Microsoft's deep-dive investigative arm within Cyber Defense Operations (CDO). We investigate complex security incidents across Microsoft's cloud, identity, and supply chain environments, conduct root cause analysis, assess attacker activity, and drive actionable remediation and detection improvements.

As a **Security Analyst II,** you will lead investigations, craft quick detections, perform threat hunting, collaborate with engineering and response teams, and help improve Microsoft's ability to detect and respond to advanced threats.

Join Microsoft's CDI Escalations team and work at the forefront of cyber defense, investigating the most complex nation-state, supply chain, cloud, and identity-based attacks targeting Microsoft. Our team goes beyond traditional incident response, we combine deep investigations, threat hunting, intelligence operationalization, and cross-organizational collaboration to identify adversaries, drive platform-wide security improvements, and build defenses that prevent future attacks. You'll partner with leaders across MSTIC, GHOST, Detection Engineering, and service teams, leverage AI-powered investigation techniques, and directly influence Microsoft's security posture while solving some of the industry's hardest security challenges.

Starting February, 2026, Microsoft employees are expected to work from a designated Microsoft office at least three days a week if they live within 50 miles (U.S.) or 25 miles (non-U.S., country-specific) of that location. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. ### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Technical Program Manager supporting Google Public Sector (GPS) Technology, you will drive the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-assurance programs across sovereign cloud and AI workstreams. You will partner directly with Tech Leads to steer architectural trade-offs, streamline multi-party dependencies, and establish AI-driven operational governance in cleared, mission-critical environments. This role requires technical judgment, executive communication skills, and an active or acquirable Top Secret security clearance to turn ambiguous technical initiatives into reliable, large-scale reality.

Google Public Sector brings the magic of Google to the mission of government and education with solutions purpose-built for enterprises. We focus on helping United States public sector institutions accelerate their digital transformations, and we continue to make significant investments and grow our team to meet the complex needs of local, state and federal government and educational institutions.

  
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of large, ambiguous technical programs from concept to global rollout. Define long-term vision, strategy, and OKRs, ensuring all initiatives align with broader organizational goals and mission-critical objectives.
* Foster consensus across engineering, product management, and UX teams. Expertly influence without authority to resolve resource gaps, navigate conflicting priorities, and bridge team boundaries for seamless execution.
* Participate in architectural reviews and design discussions. Provide high-level technical judgment on critical trade-offs.
* Identify and mitigate complex technical risks and dependencies. Develop robust contingency plans for critical-path items to ensure the on-time delivery of high-impact features.
* Establish governance structures and communication cadences for executive leadership visibility. Implement an AI-first approach by utilizing AI automation.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager, Global Functions
new_jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**

You’re a strategic and collaborative project management professional with a passion for delivering enterprise-wide initiatives and ensuring business adoption for a lasting impact. As a Project Manager at WSP, you’ll lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive organizational change and operational excellence. You’ll work closely with Program Management Office and business partners and functional leads to enable execution and adoption of the transformation roadmap.

**Where Your Ideas Matter –** If you're ready to take your career to the next level, this role offers the chance to work on projects that push boundaries and impact communities worldwide. Be part of a team that values your ideas, expertise, and growth.

**Your Impact**

**Strategic Project Delivery**  
Lead the planning and execution of high-impact, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across corporate functions such as HR, Legal, Procurement, Marketing & Communications, and Finance. Ensure alignment with organizational goals and stakeholder expectations.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**  
Partner with functional leads and business and technology stakeholders to align on project objectives, confirm scope and success metrics. Foster collaboration across matrixed teams to drive accountability and shared ownership.

**Organizational Design and Change Enablement**  
Enable stakeholder adoption and ensure solutions are embedded into day-to-day operations to realize intended business benefits.

**Governance and Reporting**  
Establish and maintain governance structures, reporting frameworks, and communication plans that support transparency and informed decision-making. Prepare updates and support steering committee discussions.

**Risk and Issue Management**  
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues. Proactively escalate challenges and recommend solutions to maintain momentum and delivery confidence.

**Tool and Process Optimization**  
Leverage tools such as Smartsheet, SharePoint, and PowerPoint to manage project plans, track deliverables, and communicate progress. Continuously seek opportunities to improve project delivery processes and tools.

**The skills that set you apart**

7+ years of experience managing complex, multi-functional projects in financial services, engineering, or public sector environments..

Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-functional projects with a strategic lens and a focus on measurable outcomes.

Skilled in building trust and alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, including senior leadership, functional leads, and delivery teams.

Experience in assessing stakeholder impact and enabling adoption, with familiarity in ADKAR, Prosci, Lean Change frameworks or similar.

Adept at embedding governance structures and reporting mechanisms that drive accountability and transparency.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling narratives.

PMP certification required; Agile Certified Practitioner is an asset. Proficiency in Smartsheet, SharePoint, and PowerPoint.

***Make Your Mark with WSP***

*If you're driven by purpose and impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career with us.*

**#LI-SB1**

  

At **WSP** , we exist to shape communities to advance humanity.
  
  
It’s why we bring people together who are wired to solve complex challenges - engineers, scientists, advisors, and technical experts who are driven by a common passion - to redefine what’s possible and shape what comes next. We are Visioneers.
  
  
As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, we partner with clients across transportation, infrastructure, environment, buildings, energy, water, mining and metals. We pair deep local knowledge with global insights to pioneer solutions designed to leave a lasting, positive impact.
  
  
At **WSP** , you’ll join a community of brilliant minds that push boundaries every day - applying deep expertise and fuelling innovation to help create a more connected and resilient future. Here, your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and you are encouraged to bring your authentic self to work. We empower our people to collaborate across disciplines, challenge the status quo, and shape a career with purpose.
  
  
Join us.

new_jobs.title: GSOC Regional Program Manager, EMEA
new_jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience implementing security resilience programs impacting teams across multiple regions.
* Experience with multidisciplinary program management in an organization.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Ability to identify, build, improve, or optimize relevant business processes.
* Ability to lead projects by navigating priorities, measurable objectives, dependencies, planning, resourcing, scheduling, budgeting, implementation and subsequent monitoring.
* Ability to analyse business objectives and strategies by proactively identifying impactful opportunities or gaps in systems and workflows.
* High ethical standards with demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information.
* Excellent judgement, discretion and diplomacy skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive incidents and crises, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team. As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.

The Global Security Operations Center is GSRS’s 24/7 ecosystem for intake, triage, management and escalation of physical security incidents and threats.

As a GSOC Program Manager, you act as the focal point and principal enabler of program delivery at the regional level. This role supports the GSOC Senior Program Manager (SPgM) with the delivery of multidisciplinary projects and programs spanning people, processes and technology. As a critical enabler of the GSOC strategy and vision, the GSOC Program Manager must leverage a broad skill set across multiple complex workstreams while acting as a strategic partner to key stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support complex cross-functional programs of work, leading both discreet projects and the local implementation of global initiatives as directed by the GSOC Senior Program Manager.
* Drive operational excellence across programs through maturing project documentation, standardizing monitoring of key performance indicators, and effective knowledge management.
* Maintain and develop cross-functional partnerships with key GSRS and external stakeholders, acting as regional representatives for GSOC programs.
* Act as a liaison to partners and support the Regional SOC Manager to improve operational delivery through effective change management, communications and stakeholder engagement.
* Contribute to the GSRS mission to protect, sustain and enable Google’s ability to thrive. Cultivate team norms that foster psychological safety and mutual respect.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. new_jobs.title: Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

DXC Technology is committed to building diverse, inclusive teams. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and particularly encourage interest from women, underrepresented groups, and neurodivergent candidates. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the hiring process and are dedicated to creating a supportive, accessible environment for everyone.

  

**Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst**

**Location: Farnborough (onsite 5 days per week)**

  

**Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations.**

  

The Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, integrity, and actionability of hardware asset data across the full asset lifecycle — from procurement through deployment, operation, redeployment, and disposal. This role is the data backbone of the Hardware Asset Management function, providing the trusted information foundation upon which financial, contractual, compliance, and operational decisions are made.

Aligned to ITAM (IT Asset Management) industry standards and frameworks — including ISO 19770, IAITAM best practices, and ITIL 4 IT Asset Management practice — the HAM Data Analyst ensures that hardware asset records are accurate, reconciled, auditable, and continuously improved. The role operates at the intersection of asset management, configuration management, procurement, finance, operations, and compliance.

This is not a passive data entry role. The HAM Data Analyst is expected to proactively identify data quality issues, reconcile discrepancies between data sources, challenge inaccurate records, and drive the data maturity of the hardware asset estate to a level that supports confident decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Hardware Asset Data Management & Quality

* Own and maintain the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of hardware asset records within the ITAM tool, CMDB, and associated asset repositories.
* Perform regular data quality audits across hardware asset records — identifying gaps, duplicates, orphaned records, misclassifications, and stale data.
* Reconcile hardware asset data across multiple sources including ITAM tools, CMDB, procurement systems, financial systems, discovery tools, and physical audit results.
* Develop and maintain data quality KPIs and dashboards to provide visibility of asset data health to stakeholders and leadership.
* Enforce data standards, naming conventions, classification taxonomies, and mandatory field requirements for hardware asset records.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, escalating systemic issues to process owners and data source owners.
* Ensure asset records reflect the current state of the physical estate — not just what was originally procured or deployed.

Hardware Asset Lifecycle Data Tracking

* Maintain accurate records across all stages of the hardware asset lifecycle:

**Lifecycle Stage**

**Data Analyst Responsibility**

Request & Procurement

Validate asset data at point of purchase order and goods receipt; ensure procurement records feed accurately into the asset register

Receipt & Warehousing

Confirm asset receipt records match purchase orders; validate serial numbers, models, and quantities

Deployment & Installation

Ensure deployment records are updated with location, assigned user, CI relationships, and operational status

In-Service / Operational

Maintain current records for location, ownership, status, warranty, support contracts, and configuration changes

Move / Add / Change (MAC)

Track and update records for asset moves, additions, changes, and redeployments

Redeployment & Reuse

Update records when assets are recovered, refurbished, and redeployed — ensuring full chain of custody

Decommission & Disposal

Validate disposal records including data sanitisation evidence, environmental compliance, and certificate of destruction

End of Life / End of Support

Track and report on assets approaching or past vendor end-of-life (EOL) and end-of-support (EOS) dates

Discovery & Reconciliation

* Reconcile hardware asset data between the authoritative asset register and automated discovery tool outputs to identify:
  + **Ghost assets** — assets in the register but not found by discovery (potentially lost, stolen, decommissioned, or misrecorded).
  + **Unmanaged assets** — assets found by discovery but not in the register (potentially unauthorised, shadow IT, or missed intake).
  + **Data mismatches** — discrepancies in serial numbers, models, locations, ownership, or status between sources.
* Produce regular reconciliation reports and drive resolution of discrepancies with operational and support teams.
* Work with infrastructure, network, and endpoint teams to improve discovery coverage and data accuracy.
* Support physical audit and stock verification activities by providing data extracts, variance analysis, and reconciliation support.

Reporting & Analytics

* Produce regular and ad-hoc hardware asset reports and dashboards covering:
  + Asset inventory by type, location, business unit, status, and lifecycle stage.
  + Data quality metrics (completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency).
  + Warranty and support contract coverage and expiry.
  + End-of-life and end-of-support exposure.
  + Asset utilisation and underutilisation indicators.
  + Cost of ownership and depreciation tracking (in collaboration with finance).
  + Disposal and environmental compliance status.
  + Reconciliation status and variance trends.
* Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to the HAM Manager, ITAM Manager, and senior stakeholders.

Receipt & Warehousing

Deployment & Installation

In-Service / Operational

Maintain current records for location, ownership, status, warranty, support contracts, and configuration changes

Move / Add / Change (MAC)

Redeployment & Reuse

Decommission & Disposal

**Mortgage Operations Analyst (German Speaking)**

Location: Zurich Switzerland

Type: Full-time

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Mortgage Operations Analyst to join our Credit Operations team. The ideal candidate will play a key role in ensuring the accurate and timely processing of mortgage loans through to closing. This role requires excellent organizational skills, in-depth knowledge of mortgage processing procedures, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Review and process mortgage loan applications to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate and communicate with loan officers, underwriters, title companies, appraisers, and borrowers to collect required documentation.
* Verify borrower information including income, assets, employment, and credit.
* Maintain loan processing pipeline and track progress to ensure on-time closings.
* Perform quality control checks to ensure loan files meet all investor and compliance guidelines.
* Identify and resolve processing issues or delays proactively.
* Input and update data in loan origination systems and other platforms as needed.
* Ensure compliance with FINMA and other relevant mortgage regulations.
* Provide regular status updates to borrowers and stakeholders.
* Support audit requests and post-closing reviews.

**Eligibility Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor's degree in business, finance, or related field preferred.
* 1+ years of mortgage processing or related mortgage operations experience, here in Switzerland
* Good knowledge of Swiss mortgage products (fixed, SARON, etc) processing procedures, and regulatory guidelines.
* Experience in credit processing systems (e.g. Avaloq, Finnova).
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines.
* Familiarity with compliance standards (e.g. FINMA)
* Notary designation is a plus.
* Languages
  + Fluent, German (spoken and written)
  English and/or French an advantage

PRIMARY PURPOSE
  
These positions are located at NAS Pt. Mugu, CA and Edwards AFB, CA.
  
CNA is hiring for Associate Research Analysts to join their Advanced Technology Assessment (ATA) Division. Staff at this level will provide research, analytical, and technical support on a range of projects.
  
  
As part of the Department of the Navy’s Federally Funded Research and Development Center (FFRDC), CNA’s Advanced Technology Assessments (ATA) division provides analysis that evaluates the military utility and efficacy of emerging defense technologies and prototypes, operational test and evaluation of DoD programs of record, and tactics development and resourcing decisions for existing naval aircraft.
  
  
Analyses from ATA help the Navy make data-informed resourcing, training, and modernization decisions for new and existing defense technologies, with a focus on naval aircraft. Our research supports defense innovation programs to ensure operational effectiveness and lethality and to maintain the technological superiority of US military forces. ATA also contributes independent analyses to the testing of new aviation systems and the development of tactics to optimize the effectiveness of existing aircraft.
  
CNA fosters an inclusive culture that values diverse backgrounds and perspectives.
  
Our flexible and engaging work environment encourages iterative and creative collaboration at every stage of the problem solving process. Our employees are committed to helping clients develop effective solutions to better manage their programs through scientific, data-driven approaches. Actively engages with colleagues and works with manager to identify opportunities for collaborations within team and division. Seeks out others working on similar topics.
  
  
4. Supports business development efforts and/or marketing activities by conducting background research and helping prepare materials under the direction of more experienced staff.
  
  
5. Limited interaction with sponsors/clients and their study POCs under the supervision of an experienced colleague.
  
  
6. Impact largely confined to individual project work.
  
  
7. Demonstrates basic, effective communication skills, both written and oral. Can effectively present work to colleagues and CNA managers.
  
  
8. Works under close supervision on focused, well-structured pieces of projects.
  
  
9. Exhibits a positive attitude in interactions with colleagues and clients/sponsors. Serves as an effective member of project or research team by supporting leadership as needed.
  
  
10. Performs other duties as assigned.
  
JOB REQUIREMENTS
  
**1. Education:** Minimum master’s degree in science, Technology, Engineering, Math (STEM), aeronautical engineering or equivalent experience
  
  
**2. Experience:** Typical minimum requirements Master’s & 0+ years of experience in research and analysis.
  
  
**3. Skills:** Facility with Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Access, Powerpoint); Ability to manage databases; Ability to gather and organize information on policies, systems, problems, or procedures; Strong critical thinking and organizational skills; Basic knowledge of research techniques; Ability to plan and organize tasks effectively, both as an individual contributor and as a team member; Basic, effective communication skills.

new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview:** Established in California in 2013, Green Water and Power has rapidly grown to operate in over 35 states, positioning itself as a leader in the sustainable energy sector. Named the #1 electric vehicle (EV) installer in America, we take pride in having deployed more than 14,000 EV chargers and completed approximately 5 megawatts (MW) of solar energy projects.

As an EVITP (Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Training Program) certified turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firm, we leverage our in-house expertise to efficiently manage and execute large-scale projects. Our dedication to sustainability and quality extends beyond project completion; we also provide comprehensive operation and maintenance services to ensure optimal performance for the projects we develop, as well as for third-party installations.

**Position Overview:** Green Water and Power is seeking an experienced Project Manager to build and lead our new dedicated Greenfield Construction Team. This role owns new-build EV charging infrastructure projects from raw, undeveloped land through energization and handoff to our Operations & Maintenance team, including site civil work, underground utilities, concrete foundations, electrical service, and charger installation. You will direct a traveling team of skilled trades and subcontractors on projects nationwide. This is a high-visibility leadership position for a seasoned construction professional who has delivered ground-up projects and wants the opportunity to shape a team and a playbook from the start.

**Pre-Construction & Planning:**

* Lead due diligence and pre-construction site walks, reviewing geotechnical reports, survey and topographic data, existing utilities, site access, and drainage.
* Review civil, structural, and electrical plan sets and single-line diagrams with engineering; identify constructability issues and value-engineering opportunities before mobilization.
* Develop baseline and look-ahead schedules, budgets, and staffing and equipment plans that sequence excavation, underground, concrete, backfill, and electrical work.
* Coordinate service applications and make-ready work with serving utilities, including transformer pad, service, and metering requirements, and track utility milestones against the schedule.

Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations Force de Vente au sein du pôle Force de Vente, vous apportez soutien analytique expert et opérationnel, aux Directeurs de Programme en charge de nos projets de force de vente, avec des enjeux forts de développement commercial, d'ouverture de nouveaux comptes et de génération de chiffre d'affaires.

Véritable support auprès des Directeurs de Programme, **vous les appuyez au quotidien dans le pilotage de leur activité** : **vous suivez la performance des équipes terrain** **dont vous** **analysez les résultats**, vous identifiez les tendances et opportunités et vous fournissez, aux Directeurs de Programmes, les analyses nécessaires à la construction de leurs recommandations et plans d’actions.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* Comprendre les enjeux du programme, les objectifs fixés et les attentes du client.

* Faire évoluer les indicateurs et outils en fonction des besoins du programme et des attentes clients identifiées.

**Suivre et Analyser la performance**
-------------------------------------

* Suivre et analyser les résultats et performances des équipes terrain (par région, commercial, produit, point de vente).

* Identifier les écarts, les tendances, les opportunités et les leviers d'amélioration.

* Assurer le rôle de key user : former les collaborateurs aux outils de suivi et de collecte, être référent(e) sur les procédures et accompagner les utilisateurs en cas d'anomalie.

* Piloter les contrôles de qualité, de cohérence et d'exhaustivité des informations remontées du terrain, et superviser le collaborateur junior en charge de ces contrôles.

* Participer à l'amélioration continue des process et à la veille concurrentielle et marché.

De formation supérieure (école de commerce, marketing ou analyse de données), vous justifiez d'une **expérience consolidée en tant que Business Analyst**, en **analyse de données et pilotage de la performance,** idéalement précédée d'une première expérience commerciale (terrain, développement commercial, gestion de comptes) ou de chef de projet / pilotage de programme.

Vous avez une culture du terrain et **une forte sensibilité business** : vous savez aller au-delà des chiffres, identifier les enseignements clés et les transformer en recommandations d’actions concrètes pour les équipes.

Vous maîtrisez **Excel à un niveau avancé** et avez une bonne maîtrise de **Power BI** pour lire, comprendre et contrôler les rapports et indicateurs existants. Vous savez notamment vérifier la cohérence des résultats, comprendre les règles de calcul et challenger les constructions auprès de l’équipe Data.

Vous comprenez les grands **principes des flux de données**, notamment les fichiers FTP et les API, afin de dialoguer efficacement avec l’équipe Data et de contribuer au suivi des sujets. Une expérience avec des outils d’intelligence artificielle comme Claude est un plus.

Organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et doté(e) d'un bon sens relationnel, vous aimez travailler en transverse avec les équipes terrain et projet tout comme auprès des équipes clients. Curieux(se) et force de proposition, **vous savez rendre des informations complexes simples, lisibles et actionnables**.

**Company Description**  

* **Application Opening:** October 7, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** May close at any time but not before October 21, 2026
* **Work Location:** Hybrid with onsite and remote weekly schedule
* **Shift:** Monday-Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Full-Time)

**Appointment Type**

This is a Temporary Exempt (TEX), full-time position. This position is excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process, is considered “at will” and shall serve at the discretion of the Appointing Officer. The duration of the appointment shall not exceed 36 months.

**Who We Are**

Through the provision of coordinated, compassionate, and high‐quality services, the Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing strives to make homelessness in San Francisco rare, brief, and one time. The Department provides assistance and support to homeless and at‐risk youth, adults and families to prevent imminent episodes of homelessness and end homelessness for people in San Francisco. Services including outreach, homelessness prevention, emergency shelter, drop‐in centers, transitional housing, supportive housing, short‐term rental subsidies, and support services to help people exit homelessness. For more information on the department, please visit our https://hsh.sfgov.org/.

**What We Do**

San Francisco is a pioneer in homeless services and a leader in providing supportive housing as a permanent exit from homelessness. The Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH), founded in 2016, is a national leader in the movement to end homelessness by developing a coordinated, equity-driven, client-focused system of compassionate services while piloting innovative models, and implementing best practice solutions with measurable results.

HSH’s Homelessness Response System (HRS) oversees and implements a system of care that shelters, houses, and serves approximately 15,000 people daily. Major programs include: street outreach and service connection through the Homeless Outreach Team (SFHOT); 3,600 + bed shelter system for transitional age youth, adults and families including shelters for members of the LGBTQ community; rapid rehousing rental subsidies for families, adults, older adults, and transitional aged youth; the Problem Solving and flexible financial assistance programs; and robust supportive housing programs with over 14, 500 units which provide housing and services to formerly homeless transitional age youth, individuals, and families.

 **Job Description**

The Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH) has an exciting opportunity for an excellent communicator, experienced business analyst, and energetic individual who is passionate about solving homelessness for our community. This highly motivated and team-oriented person will play a key role within the Department’s ONE System Team. Under the general direction of the ONE System Director, the Senior IS Business Analyst will oversee and provide technical leadership for ONE System processes and projects.

The ONE System is an enterprise Software as a Service (SaaS) system and serves as San Francisco’s Homeless Management Information System (HMIS). The ONE System supports HSH and its 75+ community-based organizations to provide a unified system for the City’s Homelessness Response System. The ONE System operationalizes, streamlines, and tracks workflows related to outreach, assessment, prioritization, referral, and placement for families, youth, and individuals seeking housing, shelter and other vital programs and services.

The Senior Business Analyst will support and oversee key aspects of a project to automate the flow of case management data via APIs from individual provider/CBO systems into the ONE System. Currently, providers spend significant time entering duplicative information into their own case management system and the ONE System. By replacing duplicative, manual tasks with an automated data flow, provider case managers can devote more time serving clients. The position will work with various project stakeholders, including HSH program teams, the Department of Technology, community providers, and the ONE System software vendor. The position will generate technical documentation, participate in testing and quality assurance activities, build and maintain dashboards to monitor data and track key metrics, help troubleshoot technical issues, and make process improvement recommendations.

The successful candidate will be a good listener with the ability to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders and the software vendor. They will bridge communication gaps between these groups to meaningfully contribute to the success of the project. If you love finding ways to use technology to help improve the lives of people, this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

**Essential duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Develop technical documentation (e.g., data dictionaries and mapping templates) to support ingesting data from external systems into ONE via an API.

* Support stakeholder communication and engagement by developing slide decks and targeted messaging materials for information sessions. Help facilitate and/or present at stakeholder meetings.
* Contribute to a “Provider API Onboarding Toolkit”, which will serve as a scalable toolkit to streamline the onboarding process for providers to participate in the project.
* Provide data mapping guidance to providers on mapping their source data structures into the required format for successful ingestion into ONE.

Conducts research, data analysis, budgeting, forecasting and reporting in support of business decision making, strategy and operations. Participates in business process improvement, quality control and other initiatives. Develops, manages and coordinates performance and quality assessment, business process re-engineering, change management, communication and training.
  
  
PG&E is providing the hourly rate range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual hourly rate paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity.
  
  
Compensation The position has an hourly pay range of $35.10 to $52.40, with a midpoint of $43.75. Based on the candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity considerations, we would typically target an offer around the midpoint of the range. Final compensation will be determined based on qualifications, experience, and alignment with comparable employees in similar roles.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
Performs standard analysis and works with existing data models
  
Pulls data to populate standard reports.
  
Presents data and findings to senior peers or internal clients
  
Tracks existing metrics
  
Learning to apply basic knowledge and develop professional skill set
  
Assist other Business Analysts using established processes, practices and procedures as directed
  
Communicates with peers inside and outside of the department, providing information or exchanging data
  
Participates on project teams
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:**  
Bachelor of Science in Business, Finance, Economics or related discipline
  
Must have a degree conferred by the start date.
  
  
**Desired:**  
Qualitative and quantitative analytical skills
  
Basic knowledge of fundamental analysis
  
Organizational and prioritization skills
  
Verbal and written communication skills
  
Adaptable to changing business conditions and ambiguity
  
Presentation skills to convey findings to varied audiences
  
Manage multiple assignments with demanding time constraints
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Project, Visio or similar Software
  
  
PG&E is unable to provide VISA sponsorship to students on an F-1, J-1 or other student visa for this position.
